jobs.description:

----------------

Customand was created with a simple mission: to provide individuals, families, and businesses with a seamless transition from one place to another. Our team of trained professionals uses modern equipment, industry\-approved packing techniques, and best\-in\-class customer support to ensure that every relocation, whether local or long\-distance, is executed with precision and care

We are seeking a reliable and detail\-oriented Entry Level Project Coordinator to support the planning, organization, and coordination of moving and relocation projects at our Los Angeles, CA location. * Assist with coordinating daily moving and relocation projects from planning through completion.
* Help organize project schedules, timelines, assignments, and operational details.
* Communicate with internal teams to ensure project tasks and deadlines are clearly understood.
* Assist with coordinating moving crews, equipment, supplies, and transportation requirements.

-----------------

* High School Diploma or equivalent required.
* Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in Business, Management, Communications, Logistics, or a related field is preferred.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Clear written and verbal communication abilities.
* Basic computer skills, including email, data entry, and document management.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records.

**Benefits**

* Competitive pay
* Paid training
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* Paid time off (PTO)
* Weekly pay
* Opportunities for advancement

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Overview**


Since our founding in 1924, we've cut cardiovascular disease deaths in half, but there is still so much more to do. To overcome today’s biggest health challenges and accelerate this progress, we need passionate individuals like you. Join our movement, be part of the progress, and help ensure a healthier future for all. You matter, and so does the impact you can make with us.


The American Heart Association has an excellent opportunity for a Project Coordinator in our Quality, Outcome Research, \& Analytics (QORA) department!


This is a full\-time, benefits\-eligible, grant\-funded opportunity. Current funding will expire April 1, 2027 with the possibility of extension.


This position can be home\-based.


The Association offers many resources to help you maintain work\-life harmonization through your changing needs and life situations. To help you be successful, you will have access to Heart U, our award\-winning corporate university, as well as additional training and support, locally.


\#TheAHALife is more than a company culture; it is our way of life. It embodies our commitment to work\-life harmonization and is guided by our core values where our employees can thrive both personally and professionally. Discover why you will Be Seen. Be Heard. Be Valued at the American Heart Association by following us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, and at heart.jobs.


**Responsibilities**


The Project Coordinator supports the successful execution of health sciences research and measure development initiatives through project coordination, administrative support, stakeholder engagement, and program operations. Working closely with internal staff, subject matter experts, researchers, and external partners, this role coordinates meetings and activities, maintains project documentation and databases, supports reporting efforts, and ensures smooth day\-to\-day operations.


* Support day\-to\-day operations of initiatives, including scheduling internal, external, and cross\-functional meetings, managing agendas, capturing notes and action items, tracking follow\-up activities, coordinating materials, and maintaining project documentation.
* Develop, input, and maintain information in project tracking systems, databases, SharePoint sites, and other software platforms.
* Handle administrative and financial tasks, including processing invoices, tracking budgets and expenses, and supporting contract and grant administration activities.
* Support virtual meeting logistics and technology setup.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for project participants, subject matter experts, and external partners, coordinating communications, responding to inquiries, and assisting with onboarding activities.
* Prepare and maintain project documentation, status reports, meeting summaries, dashboards, stakeholder updates, and other materials aligned with project goals and timelines.
* Assist with the development and dissemination of program materials, templates, reports, and resources.
* Coordinate project timelines, deliverables, and meeting schedules to support successful execution of research and measure development activities.

**Qualifications**


* High School Diploma or equivalent.
* Minimum of three (3\) years of relevant experience that includes administrative and/or project coordination experience.
* Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously and meet specified timelines.
* Administrative expertise with sophisticated clerical responsibilities and data management.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills.
* Effective interpersonal skills with proven ability to develop collaborative working relationships internally and externally.
* Experience coordinating meetings, events, or project activities across multiple stakeholder groups.

**Here are some of the preferred experience and skills we are seeking:**


* Bachelor's degree in health sciences, public health, healthcare administration, research, or a related field.
* Experience supporting health sciences, research, quality improvement, measurement, or healthcare\-related projects.
* Experience working with subject matter experts, researchers, healthcare professionals, or external partners.
* Knowledge of basic data tracking, reporting, or research support processes.

**Proficiency Requirement**


* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint. Experience working with project management, database, or collaboration systems is a plus.

**Compensation \& Benefits**


The expected pay range will be $20\.51 per hour to $25\.64 per hour. Pay is commensurate with experience; geographic differentials to the pay range may apply. The American Heart Association reserves the right to pay more or less than the posted range. The American Heart Association invests in its people. Here are the main components of our total rewards package. Visit Rewards \& Benefits to see more details.


* **Compensation** – Our goal is to ensure you have a competitive base salary. That’s why we regularly review the market value of jobs and make adjustments, as needed.
* **Performance and Recognition** – You are rewarded for achieving success through annual salary planning and incentive programs; eligibility for an incentive program is based on the type of position.
* **Benefits** – We offer a wide array of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance, along with a robust retirement program that includes an employer match and automatic contribution. As a mark of our commitment to employee well\-being, we also offer an employee assistance program, employee wellness program and telemedicine, and medical consultation.
* **Professional Development –** You can join one of our many Employee Resource Groups (ERG) or be a mentor/mentee in our professional mentoring program. Heart U is the Association’s national online university, with more than 100,000 resources desi

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator II – Medically Associated Science & Technology (MAST) Program
jobs.description:
**Job ID** 19967 **Location** Los Angeles, California, United States **Job Category** Academic / Research **Date posted** 08/26/2026

**Job Description**
-------------------


**Join Cedars\-Sinai and become part of a team that is at the forefront of medical advancements!**


**About the Team**


The MAST program at Cedars\-Sinai Medical Center is dedicated to the development of novel drugs and devices to diagnose and treat patients. This innovative program is working to develop new diagnostics and therapeutics to treat patients with illnesses related to imbalances or alterations in the Microbiome. To learn more, please visit: https://www.cedars\-sinai.org/research/areas/science\-tech.html.


**About the Role**


The Clinical Research Coordinator II works independently providing study coordination including screening of potential patients for protocol eligibility, presenting non\-medical trial concepts and details, and participating in the informed consent process. Responsible for accurate and timely source documents, data collection, documentation, entry, and reporting including timely response to sponsor queries. Responsible for compiling and reporting on each study including information related to protocol activity, accrual data, workload, and other research information. Presents information at regular research staff meetings. May plan and coordinate strategies for increasing patient enrollment, improving efficiency, training of personnel, or identifying new research opportunities. Ensures compliance with all federal and local agencies including the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and local Institutional Review Board (IRB).


**Primary Duties and Responsibilities:**


* Schedules patients for research visits and procedures.
* In collaboration with the physician and other medical personnel, documents thoroughly on Case Report Forms (CRFs) the following; changes in patient condition, adverse events, concomitant medication use, protocol compliance, response to study drug.
* Maintains accurate source documents related to all research procedures.
* Schedules and participates in monitoring and auditing activities.
* Notifies direct supervisor about concerns regarding data quality and study conduct.
* Works closely with a regulatory coordinator or directly with the Institutional Review Board (IRB) to submit Adverse Events, Serious Adverse Events, protocol deviations, and Safety Letters in accordance with local and federal guidelines.
* May perform other regulatory / Institutional Review Board duties, budgeting duties, and assisting with patient research billing and reconciliation.
* Maintains research practices using Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines.
* Maintains strict patient confidentiality according to HIPAA regulations and applicable law.
* May coordinate training and education of other personnel.
* May participate in centralized activities such as auditing, Standard Operating Procedure development, etc.
* May plan and coordinate strategies for improving clinical research efficiency.
* May identify quality and performance improvement opportunities and collaborate with staff in the development of action plans to improve quality.
* May identify new research opportunities and present to investigators
* Participates in required training and education programs.

**Qualifications**
------------------


**Education:**


* High School Diploma/GED is required.
* Bachelor's degree in a Science, Sociology, or related field is preferred.

**Licenses/Certifications:**


* ACRP/SOCRA certification is preferred.

**Experience:**


* Two years of clinical research experience is required.

**About Us**
------------


Cedars\-Sinai is a leader in providing high\-quality healthcare encompassing primary care, specialized medicine and research. Since 1902, Cedars\-Sinai has evolved to meet the needs of one of the most diverse regions in the nation, setting standards in quality and innovative patient care, research, teaching and community service. Today, Cedars\- Sinai is known for its national leadership in transforming healthcare for the benefit of patients. Cedars\-Sinai impacts the future of healthcare by developing new approaches to treatment and educating tomorrow's health professionals. Additionally, Cedars\-Sinai demonstrates a commitment to the community through programs that improve the health of its most vulnerable residents.


**About the Team**
------------------


Cedars\-Sinai is one of the largest nonprofit academic medical centers in the U.S., with 915 licensed beds, 2,993 physicians, 4,700\+ nurses and thousands of other healthcare professionals and staff. Choose this if you want to work in a fast\-paced environment that offers the highest level of care to people in the Los Angeles that need our care the most.

jobs.title: Music Research Coordinator, Disney Music Group
jobs.description:
The Disney Music Group (DMG) is the music hub for The Walt Disney Company (TWDC), encompassing all aspects of music commercialization and marketing: recorded music (Walt Disney Records and Hollywood Records), Disney Music Publishing, and Disney Concerts. DMG distributes music both physically and digitally and also licenses music throughout the world in various forms of media including television, print, gaming, and consumer products.

**Role Overview:**


The Music Research team works closely with production partners across The Walt Disney Company's iconic brands on music cue sheets for productions presented by our world\-class entertainment studios. Our goal is to ensure the accurate and timely delivery of music reporting to performing rights organizations and interested parties worldwide. By doing so, the team supports royalty distributions, publishing revenue, and helps maintain compliance with industry reporting requirements.

**Responsibilities:**

* Communicate with internal and external production stakeholders regarding Soundmouse onboarding and training, and provide ongoing support throughout the production lifecycle.
* Review quarterly promo reports and create music video cue sheets to submit to the Performing Rights Organizations (PROs).
* Review, edit, and approve domestic and international cue sheets as assigned.
* Review, edit, and approve Parks \& Resorts cue sheets.
* Research songs, music rights, and interested party information to support cue sheet preparation and reporting.
* Locate and provide cue sheets for owned, acquired, and licensed content, supporting a high volume of requests from internal teams, PROs, and external interested parties.
* Coordinate the transfer and retrieval of assets from physical archive storage.
* Handle various administrative and operational tasks as assigned.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 1\+ years of professional experience
* College degree and/or equivalent combination of education and work experience.
* General music industry knowledge (music publishing, licensing, and performing rights).
* Familiarity with cue sheets and music reporting workflows preferred.
* Soundmouse, RapidCue, or other automated cue sheet program experience preferred.
* Demonstrated research and analytical skills.
* Comfortable working with technology and able to learn new systems, databases, and workflows quickly.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office suite.
* Highly organized with sharp attention to detail.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build and maintain effective relationships with internal and external partners.
* Resourceful problem\-solver with the ability to resolve routine issues and seek guidance or escalate as needed.
* Ability to manage assigned priorities and deadlines while maintaining accuracy.
* Must be available to work onsite 4 days per week (Monday\-Thursday). Fridays are remote with flexibility to work onsite as needed.

  


The hiring range for this position in Burbank, CA is $51,000 to $66,000 per year based on a 40 hour work week. The amount of hours scheduled per week may vary based on business needs. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long\-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

 **Benefits**  

At Bloom Ads, we invest in you—your well\-being, growth, and future.

We are looking for team players eager to make an impact—on our clients, our company, and their own careers. If you thrive in a dynamic environment that encourages creativity and innovation, Bloom Ads is the place for you.

Our talented team of over 1,400 colleagues worldwide is our greatest asset. To deliver on revenue expectations, the Territory Account Manager will build deep partnerships with key stakeholders at named accounts and nurture large opportunities through a pipeline/funnel. You will proactively make outbound calls, schedule customer visits in your assigned territory and nurture leads from marketing through to opportunities.


This position reports to the Sales Director and is part of the Americas Commercial team and will be working remotely to cover accounts in Southern California (Los Angeles, Orange County and San Diego).

**In this role, you will have the opportunity to:**

* Utilize technical expertise and strategic thinking to identify and drive revenue growth within named focus accounts by identifying new opportunities to develop business across our full range of products and services.
* Develop and execute account plans that both build effective alliances and maximize share of wallet across Abcam’s portfolio.
* Continually provide market and competitor feedback to the organization around customer trends, market development and competitive activities observed within your territory.
* Provide regular sales forecasts to management regarding both financial and proactive activities output conducted in alignment with individual objectives and revenue goals for your territory.
* Adopt the CRM system and use its functionality and content to manage leads, activities, opportunities and provide insight into accounts.

**The essential requirements of the job include:**

* Bachelor’s degree in life sciences or related discipline as well as a minimum of 2 years field sales account management experience in life sciences, ideally in region.
* Demonstrable ability to speak to antibody\-based applications, proteomics, reagents and similar protein based solutions and products with customers and translate into business opportunities.
* Proven ability to build and manage relationships with scientific end\-users and decision\-makers in biopharma and academic markets.
* Experience in account management or technical support within life sciences with experience in selling solutions and services across complex research workflows
* Exceptional communication skills with the ability to simplify complex scientific concepts, paired with strong organizational and project management abilities and a proactive, customer\-focused approach to problem\-solving

**Travel, Motor Vehicle Record \& Physical/Environment Requirements:**

**It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:**

* Life Sciences or Biotechnology related PhD, MS is desirable.

The base salary range for this role is $95,000\-$120,000\. This is the range that we in good faith believe is the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. This range may be modified in the future.


This job is also eligible for bonus/incentive pay.


We offer comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.


Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real\-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

jobs.description:
**THE POSITION**


This position is a high\-impact role, working closely with the Branch Manager, Production Manager, and production teams to create and maintain meaningful client relationships. This person will manage existing relationships, develop new business opportunities, and identify networking opportunities within the industry.

**WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING**

**Client Service and Retention**

* Drive customer satisfaction and retention by understanding the individual needs of our customers and the spaces that bring them joy and peace
* Provide excellent service and communication with a focus on problem\-solving
* Promote high standards for customer service, safety, and LandCare's culture
* Provide organizational management, leadership and communication between the client and production team
* Maintain LandCare's Landscape Quality Audit process in conjunction with the Production Manager to identify property maintenance needs and enhancement opportunities
* Create client proposals, contracts, and recommendations and estimates that are designed to meet each client's objectives
* Coordinate between client expectations and production reality to ensure every project reflects our commitment to quality
* Promote sustainable solutions that create landscapes supporting the health of the planet while meeting client needs

**New Business Development**

* Identify new business opportunities by cultivating and maintaining business relationships with existing customers
* Actively prospect for potential clients and pursue new business relationships through authentic relationship building
* Participate in, organize, and lead networking events to foster relationships with potential and existing customers as both a leader in the industry and a representative of LandCare
* Engage with property owners who understand the transformative power of thoughtfully designed outdoor environments that benefit both people and the planet

**Professional Development**

* Participate in programs that focus on building operational excellence
* Engage in networking and growth opportunities through our Women's Initiative Network
* Join Book Clubs and other learning initiatives that foster continuous professional growth
* Access mentorship and training programs designed to advance your career in meaningful ways

 **Benefits**  

Besides the great team environment and the ability to work outside, we also have a strong benefits package for our team members:

* Competitive base salary
* Team based profit sharing program
* 401K for all employees with 3\.5% company match
* Company\-provided vehicle
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Paid Time Off Policy \+ 9 corporate holidays
* Formal training and development program

*This opportunity has a base range that represents a full\-time annual salary of $75,000\-$100,000 (commensurate with experience).*

jobs.title: Urology Account Manager - LA North
jobs.description:
At Accendra Health, we understand that healthcare is complex, and we’re here to make it easier. We help deliver care beyond traditional settings, making essential products and services more accessible through every stage of life. As part of the care team, our teammates play a critical role in delivering personalized, long\-term care for the patients we serve.

  

With deep expertise promoting health outside the hospital and a presence in communities nationwide through our Apria and Byram Healthcare brands, Accendra Health does more than just deliver the essentials.

  

If you’re interested in meaningful work with impact, explore our career opportunities and join us in our purpose of Bringing Care To Life™.

 **The base salary range is $65,000 to $75,000 annually, with an uncapped commission structure. Please note that this will be dependent on****the level****, years of experience, and geographic location.**

**POSITION SUMMARY**


The Urology Account Manager, is a key position within the sales organization. Reporting directly to the National Sales Director, Urology, this person is responsible for generating new revenue for the company, focusing solely on Urology.


**JOB FUNCTION**

* Performance to Quota: expectation that performance is 100% to quota
* Conduct daily sales calls
* Maintain and drive sales growth in the Seattle to Portland geography
* Consistent communication to all referral sources and internal partners
* Conduct sales calls with each customer utilizing the Byram Urology Value Proposition to drive new referrals to Byram.
* Expense reports are required to be completed weekly, including expense explanations and all receipts
* All administrative reports or requests are due by the outlined and required date
* Call Routing: Each rep is required to maintain a monthly calendar in Outlook/Salesforce.com showing their monthly routing.
* Stay current and trained on Reimbursement, Operations and Managed Care knowledge. This includes the ability to clearly define managed care pertinent to all customers' payer mix
* Develop Quarterly Business Plans
* Develop relationships with Urology referral sources such as Spina Bifida centers, Urology centers, Urology rehabilitation centers and large Urology practices
* Effectively identify key referrers’ and communicate the benefits of Byram’s products and services to the referrer’s patients
* Gain a long\-term commitment from the Urology Referral Source to sustain a recurring stream of new patient referrals
* Represent Byram at various conferences and trade shows throughout the United States (SCI, Abilities Expo etc…)

**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor’s Degree Preferred
* 2\-5 years of medical sales or successful outside B2B sales experience will also be considered
* Track record of success and ability to demonstrate sales growth and quota attainment
* Desire and ability to learn multiple product\-lines
* Excellent communication and organizational skills
* Computer proficiency; especially in Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook
* Due to the nature of the position, clean driving record, reliable transportation, the ability to drive a car and travel 90% of each day. Interaction with healthcare providers on site is required

As an Accendra Health employee, you have choices to fit your life. Our comprehensive benefits program is designed to meet you where you are — through all of life’s stages. We’ve got you and your family covered with benefits that support your health, finances, and overall wellness.

jobs.title: Account Manager - State Farm Agent Team Member
jobs.description:
**Benefits:**
* Licensing paid by agency
* Bonus based on performance
* Competitive salary
* Flexible schedule
* Opportunity for advancement
* Paid time off
* Training \& development
**ABOUT OUR AGENCY:**  

I opened my agency in 2022 and currently lead a team of four. Before becoming a State Farm agent, I worked in fashion PR and later gained firsthand insurance experience working with my father, who is also a State Farm agent. I’m proud to be a third\-generation State Farm agent and a graduate of Gonzaga University and Mater Dei High School.  

  

Giving back is important to me, and I’ve been a RAD Camp volunteer since 2008\. That same focus on relationships and helping others is an important part of our agency.  

  

We offer CalSavers, flexible scheduling, training programs, weekly development meetings, bonus opportunities, and a strong commitment to work\-life balance. We also love recognizing great performance through fun incentives, including our “Spin the Wheel” with gift cards and cash prizes.  

  

Our culture is fun, competitive, and focused on growth. I’m looking for someone who is a positive, loyal self\-starter with a thirst for knowledge and a desire to keep improving. If you enjoy friendly competition, want to be rewarded for your hard work, and are excited to grow with a supportive team, we’d love to meet you.  

  

**ROLE DESCRIPTION:**  

As an **Account Manager** for Keiko Mcinally \- State Farm Agent, you are vital to our daily business operations and customers’ success. You help grow our agency through meaningful customer relations and acting as a liaison between customer needs and agent office departments. You improve the lives of customers by proactively marketing relevant products and services.  

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**
* Develop and maintain customer relationships to drive retention and growth.
* Conduct policy reviews and provide recommendations to customers.
* Oversee the resolution of complex customer issues.
* Use your knowledge of our insurance products to recommend, explain and sell policies to both cold and warm leads.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**
* Experience in insurance sales or account management preferred.
* Leadership and interpersonal skills.
* Proven track record of meeting sales targets.
* Willingness to engage in sales conversations.
* Bilingual Spanish preferred.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Summary:**


The Account Manager, Strategic Partnerships is responsible for supporting key customers and channel partner accounts across our online and offline buying and media placement desks. The ideal candidate is a natural at building and maintaining strong relationships with a well\-tuned attention to detail across a high volume of accounts, maintaining satisfaction among key stakeholders at all levels. The Account Manager, Strategic Partnerships applies a “solution mindset” to remove obstacles and ensure a clear path to account success and growth. This position is the principal point of contact for all service\-related matters, anticipates the needs of clients, and works cross\-functionally to meet milestones and deadlines.

***Must be located in the Los Angeles area with monthly on\-site expectations in Irvine, CA.***

**What you will do:**

* Become a knowledgeable client partner for SoCal News Group’s online and offline media placement solutions
* Conduct required active daily outreach to current and lapsed clients to secure, retain, and upsell revenue to meet monthly and annual budget expectations, managing the pipeline through sequences and stages for new and recurring opportunities
* Facilitate necessary probing and needs analysis to develop annual brand and media strategies for placement, upsell, and cross\-sell based on overall clients' goals and objectives
* Develop campaign strategies and audience targeting recommendations per brand and product line
* Evaluate KPIs and optimize campaign performance using a data\-driven approach, leveraging insights from our AdTech and MarTech platforms
* Perform in\-depth pre\- and post\-data analysis to deliver actionable insights and recommendations that influence short\-term and long\-term online and offline media strategy
* Educate advertisers on performance metrics, insights, and how to achieve greater results
* Work cross\-functionally with sales and marketing to achieve overall company annual targets
* Support the client buying cycle and manage all post\-sales activities, including proposal coordination, material and content collection, insertion orders, billing, and other onboarding deliverables to help secure revenue and implement programs
* Increase customer retention by conducting regular performance checks to identify areas for improvement and performing data analysis for ongoing strategic reviews
* Interface with Ad Operations to resolve issues and provide the highest level of customer service

**What you will bring:**

* Bachelor's degree and 5\+ years of experience in a Strategic Account Manager or Account Executive role with demonstrated success as a high\-performing individual contributor
* Experience in omnichannel marketing, with a concentration in programmatic or social media and a discipline in understanding market penetration for in\-home media buying
* Media planning capabilities using data, analysis, and market research
* High attention to detail and ability to manage shifting priorities
* Positive attitude, high energy, and a collaborative team spirit
* Unwavering desire to learn and take direction to improve productivity
* Solid analytical skills and comfort working with numbers
* Outstanding communication skills, both written and verbal, while working as part of a team or independently
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Salesforce
* Demonstrated success working with cross\-functional teams and building strong relationships internally and externally

**Benefits and Compensation:**


The salary range is $80,000 \- $85,000 \+ cell phone stipend, mileage reimbursement, and commission (on\-target earning potential is $175,000\+). Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to geographic location, education, work experience, time in role, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, the Company offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, life and disability insurance, 401k, as well as paid time off and select paid holidays (all benefits are based on eligibility). Please click the following link for more detailed information: www.mymedianewsgroup.com

**Who we are:**


In 2016, the Southern California News Group (SCNG) rapidly became a major U.S. news organization bringing together prominent publications like the Orange County Register and Riverside Press\-Enterprise under the MediaNews Group umbrella. SCNG has become the largest news content provider in the five\-county Los Angeles metropolitan area, boasting a leading circulation nationwide with 11 daily newspapers and over a dozen community weeklies. Our mission is to connect communities by providing readers with top\-notch local news coverage and offering advertisers unparalleled access to a diverse and engaged audience. No matter the distribution vehicle \- newspaper, magazine, mobile, online \- SCNG's in\-depth reporting on local news, politics, sports, and entertainment attracts a highly desirable audience of over 8\.1 million adults weekly. This makes SCNG the leading local news provider and an indispensable marketing solution for Southern California advertisers.

***“4x Built In Best Places to Work Winner \- 2023\-2026”***

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Are you ready to take ownership of client partnerships and drive performance in facility management?**

  

Join City Wide Facility Solutions as a Facility Solutions Manager and play a key role in making our clients’ spaces shine while building your career in a collaborative, growth\-focused environment.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Be the go\-to expert for multiple client accounts, managing day\-to\-day operations, retention, and satisfaction.
* Customize service strategies and scheduling that exceed client expectations.
* Negotiate service agreements and pricing for new contracts and add\-on solutions.
* Oversee contractor relationships, ensuring compliance, quality, and clear communication on performance.
* Conduct site walkthroughs to verify standards, resolve issues, and champion excellence.
* Partner with Night Managers and the Director of Operations to execute and enhance service delivery.
* Track service activities, supplies, and client feedback in our advanced CRM and planning tools.
* Respond quickly to client concerns, troubleshooting and resolving issues with urgency.
* Monitor and manage staffing and resource needs to maintain outstanding service.

**Why City Wide:**

* Competitive salary, benefits, and growth potential.
* Dynamic, supportive team culture focused on excellence and client impact.
* Opportunities for advancement and professional development.
* Make a real difference for clients, contractors, and your career.

**Ready to drive performance and make an impact? Apply now!**

 **Requirements** **You’ll Succeed Here If:**

* You have 3\+ years’ experience in facility management, operations, or building services.
* You’re detail\-oriented, proactive, and confident in building relationships.
* You communicate clearly—verbally and in writing—with clients and teams.
* Expert in Microsoft Office and comfortable with database/CRM technology.
* You hold a high school diploma (Bachelor’s degree preferred).
* You have reliable transportation for on\-site visits.
* **Candidate must reside in or near the Long Beach \- Southwest Los Angeles area.**

  

**Benefits**  

City Wide offers a competitive salary, including commission for this position. In addition, we offer a comprehensive benefits package to include medical, dental, vision and PTO.

  

More on City Wide...


City Wide Facility Solutions is the largest management company in the building maintenance industry and services Kansas City\-based businesses. We have over 60 years of business and continue to experience healthy business growth across our communities. Our culture supports the company’s Mission: to create a Ripple Effect by positively impacting the people and communities they serve. Learn more at www.gocitywide.com


City Wide is an Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.title: Account Manager - Commercial Lines (California)
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

**Title:****A****ccount Manager \- Commercial Lines**  

**Hybrid Preferred:**Southern California (Aliso Viejo, Los Angeles County, Ontario, San Diego, or Santa Barbara)  

**Remote:** California residents  

**Book Focus:**Generalist and/or Construction \| **Required:** active property \& casualty (P\&C) license  

  

*Please note: If this position is posted as either fully remote and/or hybrid, in accordance with company policy, individuals residing within a 50\-mile radius of a branch location may be required to work onsite in a hybrid capacity as there may be occasions when on\-site presence is necessary to meet specific business needs. Additionally, our remote work policy includes having a dedicated, distraction\-free workspace.**Remote work is not a substitute for childcare, elder care, or other personal responsibilities during working hours.**To view our branch locations, please visit: ioausa.com/locations*

**About the Role****:** Manage an assigned book of business, ensuring account retention and supporting new business. Coordinate day\-to\-day administrative and customer service activities, resolving complex issues, and ensuring no errors or omissions.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Technical Competence**: Maintain technical competence and industry expertise.
* **Team Leadership**: Direct daily activities of the account management team.
* **Customer Service**: Handle customer service requests, policy administration, billing, claims, and coverage analysis.
* **Policy Management**: Manage policy expirations and renewals.
* **Renewal Process**: Conduct client research, prepare submissions, negotiate coverages, and present proposals.
* **Accounts Receivable**: Monitor reports and take action on delinquent accounts, collecting outstanding balances.
* **System Maintenance**: Maintain agency management systems and carrier/vendor platforms, ensuring data accuracy and completeness.
* **Activity Monitoring:** Monitor and maintain activity/suspense to ensure timely completion.
* **Communication:** Maintain frequent, transparent communication with the account team regarding workload status and any issues.
* **Service Excellence:** Deliver excellent service, proactively anticipate needs, and respond quickly to service requests.
* **Policy Compliance:** Stay updated on company policies and procedures.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Seek and adopt best practices to improve individual and team performance.
* **Champion IOA Values:** Demonstrate integrity and leadership.
  

  

**Ideal Candidate****Qualifications:**

* 3\-5 years of account management experience, or 5\+ years in the insurance industry
* Thorough knowledge of insurance brokerage and client needs
* Required active property \& casualty (P\&C) licensing; professional designation (CIC or equivalent) preferred
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills
* Exceptional customer service, communication, multitasking, and organizational skills
* Proficiency in MS Office (Outlook, Word, Excel)
* High School Diploma (or equivalent)
  

  

**What We Offer:**

* Competitive salaries and bonus potential
* Company\-paid health insurance
* Paid holidays, vacations, and sick time
* 401K with employer match
* Professional growth and career progression opportunities
* Respectful culture and work/family life balance
* Community service commitment
* Supportive teammates and a rewarding work environment
  

  

**What to Expect****(Application Process)****:**

* 30\-Minute Phone Screen, Online Assessments, and Interview(s)
**Salary Range**


The expected pay range for this position is $80,000\.00 \- $105,000\.00 annually depending on experience, relevant skills, and geographic location.


Insurance Office of America is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.description:
**Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.**


At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.


There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.


We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description** **AECOM** is seeking an experienced and driven **Client Account Manager \- Air Quality focused** with expertise in air quality compliance (permitting, stack testing, ambient air monitoring) and account management to support business growth and client engagement. This role is ideal for a proven sales leader with an existing book of clients, strong relationship management skills, and a deep understanding of air quality strategies. The selected candidate will be responsible for identifying and securing new business opportunities, driving revenue growth, and delivering innovative environmental solutions.


This hybrid position can be based out of AECOM's offices in Houston, TX; Austin, TX; Chicago, IL; Cincinnati, OH; Denver, CO; Fort Collins, CO; Minneapolis, MN; or Orange, CA. We are also open to candidates not located in these areas, however, must be located within the Western Region of the United States.

**Key Responsibilities include:**

* Develop and execute business strategies to expand AECOM’s air quality compliance services.
* Maintain and grow existing client relationships while identifying new opportunities in the public and private sectors.
* Leverage an existing book of clients to generate sales and secure high\-value environmental projects.
* Work closely with internal teams to develop and present proposals, technical solutions, and service offerings.
* Negotiate contracts and service agreements to align with client needs and financial objectives.
* Provide industry insight and stay updated on air quality regulations, compliance standards, and emerging trends.
* Support cross\-business collaboration to provide integrated environmental solutions across multiple sectors.
* Meet or exceed sales targets while contributing to the long\-term strategic vision of AECOM.

**About AECOM’s Environment Business Line**  

Join AECOM to be part of an expert global team who is connected through a well\-developed, worldwide, internal technical practice network through which you can learn from and brainstorm with the best in the world. AECOM is an industry\-leading, world class environmental firm, and we want you to succeed within it. We respect and encourage your own pathway to excellence via our Freedom to Grow initiative.  

  

AECOM is known for our award\-winning technical excellence, leading\-edge science and innovative project delivery. We provide sustainable solutions for some of the world’s most challenging issues. Our global clients and their projects span a variety of market sectors and geographies and require innovative technical solutions to solve wide\-ranging environmental problems.

 **Qualifications** **Minimum Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in environmental science, engineering, business, or related field.
* 8 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education in managing client accounts, sales and drive business development within air quality compliance services.
* Travel of 25\-50% will be required, as this is a client facing role.
* Valid US Driver's License and pre\-employment driving record verification are required.
* Due to the nature of the work, US Citizenship is required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree is preferred.
* 10\+ years of experience in account management, sales, and air quality compliance services.
* Proven ability to manage client accounts and drive business development initiatives.
* Strong understanding of air quality regulations, permitting, and compliance.
* Experience leading large\-scale environmental compliance projects.
* Established industry relationships with clients in government, energy, commercial, and industrial sectors.
* Experience in contract negotiations, sales forecasting, and revenue management.
* Ability to work in a matrixed organization, coordinating across multiple teams and disciplines.
* Proficiency in CRM tools, data analytics, and sales tracking platforms.

  

**Additional Information**  

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

jobs.title: Account Manager (Full-Time)
jobs.description:
Position Description  

The **Account Manager** is responsible for managing customer relationships, estimating projects, and overseeing the successful execution of assigned projects. This role is critical in driving revenue growth, providing excellent customer service, and building strong networks within the market. The Account Manager will handle "Come Do" or service work as well as project work, ensure customer satisfaction, and achieve annual revenue goals. **This is a full\-time position, with a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits offered.**

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Estimate and prepare proposals for assigned projects.
* Communicate known project hazards, risk.
* Oversee the management of projects, ensuring they are completed incident free, on time, within budget, and to client specifications.
* Handle project and/or service ("Come Do") work as required, responding promptly to customer needs.
* Meet annual sales volume goal of $3M \- $5M\+.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients, acting as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts.
* Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction by addressing inquiries and resolving issues efficiently.
* Provide consistent follow\-up and communication with clients throughout the project lifecycle.
* Identify new business opportunities within the assigned market and maintain a robust pipeline of potential projects.
* Foster and develop partnerships that lead to revenue growth and increased market share for Penhall Company.
* Work closely with the Branch Manager, sales team, and other departments to align project goals with overall company objectives.
* Communicate project progress, potential issues, and client feedback to relevant stakeholders.
* Collaborate with internal teams to ensure projects are completed efficiently and to the client’s satisfaction.
* Achieve annual revenue targets by successfully managing project delivery and cultivating client relationships.
* Track and report on performance metrics, identifying areas for improvement and adjusting strategies to meet goals.
* Build a network of industry contacts and maintain relationships with key stakeholders to enhance business opportunities.
* Participate in community and industry events to increase brand awareness and establish Penhall Company as a trusted service provider.
* Perform additional duties as assigned by the Branch Manager or other leadership.

**Essential Core Competencies**

* Relationship Management: Proven ability to develop and maintain strong, long\-term relationships with clients.
* Collaboration: Strong team player with the ability to work across departments to achieve common goals.
* Communication: Clear and effective verbal and written communication skills.
* Customer Focus: Commitment to understanding and meeting customer needs.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
### **About Northbeam**



Northbeam is building the world's most advanced marketing intelligence platform, providing top eCommerce brands a unified view of their business data through powerful attribution modeling and customizable dashboards. Our technology helps customers accurately track ad spend, understand the full customer journey, and drive profitable growth. Machine learning has been at the heart of Northbeam since day one: our full suite of measurement, spanning multi\-touch attribution, MMM\+, and incrementality, is built on it, along with laser\-accurate first\-party data. Now we're taking that foundation further, using AI to help brands operationalize their data and turn Northbeam insights into automated decisions.



We're experiencing rapid growth, have strong product\-market fit, and are looking for the right people to help us scale. This is a rare chance to make a meaningful impact at a fast\-moving, high\-growth company. At Northbeam, you'll join a team of driven, collaborative, and talented individuals who value personal growth and excellence. We'd love for you to be part of our journey.



We're a remote\-friendly company with physical offices in San Francisco and Los Angeles.

**Job Description:**
--------------------



As a Customer Success Manager at Northbeam, you will play a critical role in facilitating and coordinating support for Northbeam's enterprise customer base to improve retention and minimize customer churn. You will own a book of business and work closely with the Media Strategy team to ensure the Northbeam product is delivering outstanding value and insights for customers.



We're a remote\-first company with team members in San Francisco, Los Angeles, New York, and more.


**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------


* Provide setup support for early stage customers, eCommerce growth insights for those that are fully onboarded
* Own coordinating stakeholders internally to ensure a smooth post\-onboarding experience, general support ticket management, and product feedback/requests
* Help the Media Strategy team prepare for data reviews at a recurring cadence with the customer and follow up with deliverables (e.g. working with the team on preparing conversion lag reports for a customer)
* Proactively use internal tracking tools to investigate account health issues and customer usage data
* Reach out to at\-risk customers proactively and ensure the customer is set up for success
* Consider methods to automate and improve customer health tracking and engagement
* Work closely across multiple teams including Product, Engineering, and Media Strategy. An ideal candidate will track bug reports and more technical issues alongside the engineering team to ensure speedy resolution times
* Become an extension of our customers' data and media teams – your contributions directly impact how much they are able to take advantage of all Northbeam has to offer
* Influence Northbeam Product and Customer Success teams to push forward tools and system initiatives to improve the customer experience

**Required Experience and Skills:**
-----------------------------------



EXPERIENCE


* Bachelor's Degree or similar experience preferred, but not required
* 1\-3\+ years in a Customer Success position, ideally touching eCommerce and ad tech


TECHNICAL SKILLS


* Comfortable with typical project management tools
* Comfortable working with Hubspot and other CRM tools
* Proficient in data analytics tools


Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and location.



In addition to your base salary, we offer an equity package, comprehensive healthcare benefits (medical, dental, and vision), and a 401(k) plan. Our team enjoys a flexible PTO policy, 12 company\-paid holidays, and 12 weeks of paid parental leave. We also provide a $500 work\-from\-home stipend to support your remote setup.


**Interview Process**  

The interview process varies by role but typically begins with a 30\-minute interview with a Northbeam recruiter, followed by a video interview with the hiring manager. Next, candidates complete a role\-specific video interview followed by video or onsite interviews with several team members. The final step is a video interview with our CEO/Co\-founder. The entire interview process is usually 5\-7 interviews total and requires around 5\-8 hours of your time.



We accept applications on an ongoing basis.

About the Role

We are seeking a creative, fashion\-driven, and results\-oriented **Social Media Manager** to lead the social media presence and growth of CALI1850, Lazy Sunday, and Khaki \& Blue.

This is a hands\-on position for someone who understands fashion, social media culture, content creation, brand storytelling, and performance. We are not looking for someone who only schedules posts.

You will work closely with our Design and E\-Commerce teams while taking primary ownership of social media strategy and execution.

Key ResponsibilitiesSocial Media Strategy \& Brand Management

· Develop and execute distinct social media strategies for CALI1850, Lazy Sunday, and Khaki \& Blue.

· Establish a clear and consistent social identity, voice, and visual direction for each brand.

· Create monthly and weekly social media content calendars.

· Identify relevant fashion, lifestyle, cultural, and social media trends, then translate them into brand\-appropriate content for each target customer.

· Plan and manage Instagram posts, Reels, Stories, TikTok content, and other relevant social channels.

· Create engaging short\-form content using available product, model, lifestyle, and behind\-the\-scenes assets.

· Coordinate with designers on new products, collections, seasonal stories, and key items.

· Monitor comments, direct messages, tags, mentions, and customer engagement.

· Build relationships with followers and strengthen each brand's online community.

· Identify and coordinate appropriate influencers, creators, and micro\-influencers.

· Develop product seeding and collaboration opportunities and track creator performance.

· Develop strategies to increase qualified followers, engagement, website traffic, and conversion.

· Work with the E\-Commerce team on Instagram/Facebook advertising, boosted posts, and campaign initiatives.

· Test creative concepts, audiences, formats, and messaging.

· Identify high\-performing organic content that can be expanded through paid promotion.

Analytics \& Reporting

· Track weekly and monthly KPIs, including follower growth, reach and impressions, engagement rate, Reels/video views, website traffic, conversion and sales when measurable, and top\-performing products and content.

· Prepare a concise weekly Social Media Performance Report.

· Recommend specific actions based on performance data rather than simply reporting numbers.

Qualifications

· **Experience:** 3\-5\+ years of hands\-on social media experience, preferably in fashion, apparel, beauty, lifestyle, or consumer brands.

· **Platforms:** Strong knowledge of Instagram, TikTok, Facebook/Meta, and emerging social platforms.

· **Audience \& trends:** Strong understanding of fashion trends and young consumer behavior.

· **Growth record:** Demonstrated experience growing a brand's social media audience and engagement.

· **Content:** Experience creating short\-form video content, especially Reels and TikTok.

· **Creative judgment:** Strong visual judgment and understanding of fashion merchandising and branding.

· **Communication:** Excellent written communication and caption\-writing skills.

· **Tools:** Comfortable working with Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, CapCut, or similar content creation tools.

· **Preferred:** Understanding of Meta Business Suite / Ads Manager.

· **Additional pluses:** Shopify/e\-commerce experience and influencer or creator marketing experience.

Portfolio Requirement

**Please include links to social media accounts you have personally managed.**

Applicants should be prepared to explain and substantiate:

· Which accounts they managed and their specific responsibilities.

· Starting and ending follower counts and engagement improvements.

· Examples of successful Reels, TikToks, or campaigns.

· Analytics or other measurable results from their work.

What We Are Looking For

**Creative enough to understand fashion.**  
**Analytical enough to understand performance.**  
**Hands\-on enough to create and post content.**  
**Organized enough to manage multiple brands.**  
**Commercial enough to understand that social media ultimately needs to support brand growth and sales.**

This position will have meaningful ownership over the social media growth of our brands and will work directly with our Design and E\-Commerce teams.

Submit your resume and portfolio links, including examples of accounts and campaigns you personally managed. Applications without relevant work samples or measurable results may not receive priority consideration.

Production Coordinator / Construction Project Coordinator – Home Improvement

**C\&M Home Revival \| Long Beach, CA**  
**Full\-Time \| $25–$30/hour, depending on experience**  
**Monday–Friday \| In Office**

Help Us Keep Great Projects Moving.

C\&M Home Revival is a growing home improvement company looking for an **experienced Production Coordinator / Construction Project Coordinator** to join our team in Long Beach.

This is a key position within our production operation. You'll be responsible for helping move projects from **contract to completion**, working directly with homeowners, project managers, installers, subcontractors, vendors, and our internal team.

We're looking for someone who already understands the pace and moving parts of residential construction and can step in, take ownership, and make things happen.

**Must Have:**

**Experience with Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets is required.**

You should be comfortable working with spreadsheets, organizing information, tracking multiple projects, and keeping details accurate.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll help keep multiple projects moving at the same time — making sure the right people, materials, paperwork, appointments, and information are all in place.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Coordinate residential home improvement projects from **contract through completion**
* Schedule pre\-site meetings, installations, inspections, deliveries, and subcontractor work
* Coordinate schedules between homeowners, project managers, installers, subcontractors, vendors, and internal teams
* Order and track project materials and identify potential shortages or delays
* Confirm projects are properly prepared before crews arrive
* Track permits, inspections, approvals, contracts, change orders, and completion documents
* Maintain accurate project information, notes, schedules, and updates in the CRM
* Communicate project schedules and updates with homeowners
* Follow up with subcontractors, installers, vendors, and internal team members
* Identify scheduling conflicts and production issues before they become larger problems
* Help resolve issues and keep projects moving when things don't go according to plan
* Coordinate punch\-list items, corrections, inspections, and final completion
* Help ensure final documentation and payments are collected
* Assist with warranty and service coordination when needed
* Maintain organized project files and documentation
* Track outstanding items until they are completed
* Keep management informed of project status, delays, and issues

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone with **real construction or home improvement experience**.

You don't have to have the exact title of "Production Coordinator." If you've worked in construction operations, project coordination, scheduling, roofing, remodeling, general contracting, windows \& doors, solar, HVAC, restoration, or a similar industry, your experience may translate very well into this position.

We're looking for someone who is:

* Experienced in residential construction or home improvement
* Highly organized and detail\-oriented
* Comfortable managing multiple projects at once
* Strong with scheduling and follow\-up
* Comfortable using **Excel or Google Sheets**
* Comfortable learning and using CRM/project management software
* Professional and confident communicating with homeowners
* Comfortable communicating with subcontractors, installers, vendors, and internal teams
* Proactive when problems arise
* Able to prioritize competing deadlines
* Able to work independently and take ownership
* Reliable and consistent with follow\-through
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving environment

**Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus.**

This Isn't a "Sit at a Desk and Wait" Position

Construction has a lot of moving pieces.

A project gets sold.

Then the real work begins.

**Materials need to be ordered.**

**Permits need to be tracked.**

**Customers need to be contacted.**

**Installers need to be scheduled.**

**Subcontractors need to show up.**

**Inspections need to happen.**

**Problems need to be solved.**

And when something doesn't go according to plan, someone needs to recognize it, communicate it, and get it back on track.

**That's where you come in.**

We're looking for someone who naturally thinks:

What needs to happen next? Who is responsible? What are we waiting on? And what can I do to move this forward?

You shouldn't have to be reminded to follow up.

You shouldn't be comfortable letting something sit unresolved.

And you shouldn't wait for a customer to call before realizing there's a problem.

We want someone who **takes ownership and follows things through.**

What Success Looks Like

At the end of the day, your job is simple:

**Keep projects organized. Keep people informed. Keep jobs moving.**

A successful Production Coordinator knows the status of their projects, knows what needs to happen next, and knows what is holding a project up.

If a material hasn't arrived — you know about it.

If an installer hasn't confirmed — you follow up.

If an inspection needs to be scheduled — you get it moving.

If a homeowner needs an update — they hear from us before they have to ask.

If something goes wrong — you help find the solution.

**You become the person the team can rely on to keep things moving.**

Why Join C\&M Home Revival?

C\&M Home Revival is growing, and we're building a team of people who want to be part of that growth.

This is an opportunity to join a company where your work has a direct impact on the customer experience and the success of our projects.

We're looking for people who take pride in their work, want to grow professionally, and enjoy being part of a team where everyone has an important role in getting the job done.

Compensation \& Benefits

* **$25–$30/hour**, depending on experience
* *Full\-time* position
* Monday–Friday schedule
* In\-office position
* Paid training on company systems and proc

Irvine, California

Technology and InnovationSystems Integrations and Diagnostics

The posted salary represents the lowest and highest ranges RV Tech reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for the position. Any posted salary range pertains only to the estimated starting pay for the role. Actual starting pay is based on a number of factors, including, but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, skillset, qualifications, specific competencies, relevant education, and location.


  
**About Us**
============


Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software\-defined vehicles around the world.


The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.


**Role Summary**
================


We are looking for a highly organized and proactive Lab Operations Coordinator to keep engineering labs and test assets supplied, traceable, organized, and ready for use. This hands\-on role owns purchasing coordination, receiving, inventory, equipment records, supplier follow\-up, shipments, returns, and lab workflow for the Systems Integration and Diagnostics labs, and provides defined shared services — SAP transaction support and cross\-site part transfers — to partner engineering teams.


The position is based in Irvine, where the majority of builds and stocked material are located, and supports Palo Alto through remote coordination.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


**Purchasing and suppliers**

* Coordinate SAP requests, purchase orders, quotes, order status, backorders, invoices, returns, RMAs, and supplier follow\-up.
* Serve as the SAP execution point for partner engineering teams, absorbing recurring transactional work that currently fragments engineering time.
* Verify request completeness and escalate pricing, vendor, approval, or sourcing decisions to the appropriate owner..

**Inventory and equipment**
---------------------------


* Maintain accurate records for lab equipment, test assets, components, consumables, harness materials, spares, and shared tools within the Systems Integration and Diagnostics labs.
* Coordinate receiving, inspection, labeling, storage, issuance, asset records, calibration visibility, cycle counts, and discrepancy resolution.

**Shipping, logistics, and expediting**
---------------------------------------


* Coordinate builds with previously qualified suppliers for established, validated designs — order placement, part collection, delivery scheduling, receiving readiness, and dock coordination — so engineers are not managing routine build logistics.
* Chase and consolidate parts across sites against engineer\-provided BOMs; for example, sourcing connectors, terminals, and components stocked in Irvine for builds and first articles at other sites, and driving them to the requesting site.
* Coordinate incoming deliveries, inter\-site shipments, packing lists, tracking, carrier handoffs, and material movement between Palo Alto and Irvine.
* Support damaged shipments, missing items, returns, and supplier packing or quality issues through documented closure.

**Traceability and compliance support**
---------------------------------------


* Maintain BOM\-to\-asset traceability for test assets leaving the lab, including tagging, record linkage, and documentation sufficient to support data\-security and TISAX audit requirements.
* Apply and maintain a consistent asset tagging method (physical documentation, barcode/QR linkage to build records, or equivalent) across sites.

**Lab workflow and readiness**
------------------------------


* Maintain a visible view of requests, incoming material, shortages, equipment status, service actions, and readiness blockers.
* Coordinate with engineers and technicians around build milestones, lab capacity, need\-by dates, staging, storage, and escalation of risks.

**Process and reporting**
-------------------------


* Establish standard work for purchasing intake, receiving, inventory updates, asset tagging, shipment coordination, and issue escalation.
* Report on purchasing cycle time, open orders, overdue deliveries, inventory accuracy, calibration status, traceability coverage, and unresolved blockers.

**Qualifications**
------------------


* 3\+ years of experience in lab operations, purchasing administration, inventory control, asset management, logistics, manufacturing operations, or a similar environment


	+ 2\+ years will be considered with directly relevant lab or purchasing operations experience.
* Experience with an ERP or procurement platform; SAP experience strongly preferred, Coupa familiarity a plus.
* Strong spreadsheet, data\-management, recordkeeping, follow\-through, and communication skills.
* Ability to understand basic electrical/electronic lab equipment, part\-number structures, inventory concepts, calibration needs, and safe material handling.
* Experience supporting automotive, aerospace, electronics, hardware development, HIL, validation, prototype, or test\-lab environments is preferred.
* Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, asset\-management systems, barcode/QR tracking, ESD practices, or multi\-site material movement is a plus.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Coordinator
jobs.description:
Infinite Electronics powers a global portfolio of specialized connectivity companies delivering reliable engineered solutions worldwide. Built as a unified platform for speed, scale and reliability, the company combines shared infrastructure, best\-in\-class logistics and deep engineering expertise to support mission\-critical connectivity needs. Through scalable global operations and rapid development capabilities, Infinite helps customers accelerate innovation and bring new ideas to market.
  
  

**Position Description:**  

The Strategic Account Coordinator is a support\-focused role designed to assist Outside Sales Representatives (OSRs) in the management and execution of customer account activities within assigned strategic accounts. This position does not carry a sales quota, engage in prospecting, or own revenue targets. Instead, the role serves as a key operational partner, ensuring timely, accurate, and efficient handling of customer requests, order coordination, and internal alignment across teams.
  
  

This role is responsible for supporting the customer’s experience by managing day\-to\-day account activities, coordinating cross\-functional resources, and ensuring follow\-through on customer needs. The Strategic Account Coordinator acts as a central point of contact for order status, quoting coordination, and issue resolution, working closely with Sales, Operations, Product, and Customer Support teams to deliver a seamless experience.
  
  

General Duties and Responsibilities
  
Account Support \& OSR Partnership
  
* Partner closely with Outside Sales Representatives to support account activities and execution of customer requests.
* Assist with maintaining account information, activity tracking, and documentation within CRM systems.
* Support preparation for customer interactions, including gathering order details, status updates, and internal insights.
* Coordinate follow\-up actions based on OSR direction and customer needs.


Customer Communication \& Order Support
  
* Serve as a primary contact for customers regarding order status, shipping updates, and general inquiries.
* Respond to customer requests via phone and email with timely, accurate, and professional communication.
* Ensure clear communication of order updates, requirements, and next steps.
* Escalate and coordinate resolution of customer issues as needed.


Quote \& RFQ Coordination
  
* Support the quoting process by coordinating RFQs with internal teams.
* Ensure accurate and timely submission of quote requests and follow\-ups.
* Maintain visibility into quote status and communicate updates to customers and OSRs.
* Assist with gathering required technical or commercial information to support quoting activities.


Cross\-Functional Coordination
  
* Collaborate with Product, Operations, Customer Service, and other internal teams to support order fulfillment and issue resolution.
* Act as a liaison to ensure alignment between customer expectations and internal execution.
* Help coordinate actions across departments to move orders and requests forward efficiently.


Order \& Issue Resolution
  
* Monitor open orders and proactively identify delays or risks.
* Follow up internally to ensure timely resolution of order\-related issues.
* Support resolution of discrepancies, including order changes, shipping issues, or documentation needs.
* Escalate critical issues appropriately and track progress through resolution.


Administrative \& Process Support
  
* Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, order activity, and account updates.
* Ensure CRM and internal systems are kept up to date with current information.
* Support reporting needs related to account activity, order status, and customer communications.
* Assist with documentation and process adherence to ensure consistency and efficiency.
* Provide updates on account performance, pipeline health, risks, and growth opportunities.
* Support forecast accuracy and revenue reporting for the Industrial BU.
* Maintain detailed account records and CRM activity tracking.


Key Responsibilities
  
* Partner closely with outside sales to build and maintain strategic account plans within the CRM, driving revenue growth and strengthening the sales pipeline.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for customers on key sales activities, including quotes and service follow\-ups, ensuring all responses meet established SLAs.
* Proactively schedule sales visits and follow\-up activities for outside sales to maintain sales momentum, documenting actions and next steps in the CRM.
* Develop deeper relationships within targeted strategic accounts by expanding connections across multiple contacts and functional areas within the customer’s organization.


**Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**  

* Strong interpersonal skills, business acumen, and a customer\-centric focus with urgency to achieve strategic objectives.
* Minimum 5 years of strategic or technical sales experience, including account development, extensive phone contact, and a track record of profitable growth.
* Expertise in technical sales, subsystems, integrated solutions, product lines, market trends, and industry landscape.
* Excellent professional communication skills, both written and spoken, with proper grammar, tone, and messaging.
* Ability to interpret instructions in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, Teams, and general computer applications; CRM experience preferred.
* Experience in fast\-paced sales environments, managing multiple accounts and complex opportunities.
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively in a team\-based sales model aligned with outside/field sales.
* Strategic thinker with strong execution, follow\-through, and relationship\-management skills.
* Capable of sitting, standing, walking regularly, and occasionally lifting 0–40 pounds.

jobs.title: Retail Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Bedrosians Tile and Stone**


Since 1948, Bedrosians have been a trusted leader in tile and stone. With 40\+ showrooms across the country, a growing eCommerce site, and strong relationships with designers, contractors, and retailers, we are investing in the future of omnichannel marketing to deliver seamless and inspiring customer experiences.

 **Position Overview**


The Retail Marketing Coordinator supports the execution of in\-store and regional marketing initiatives across Bedrosians showroom locations and retail channels. This role is focused on coordinating promotional campaigns, maintaining in\-store marketing assets, and assisting with product launches and retail events. The ideal candidate is organized, detail\-oriented, and enthusiastic about bringing marketing ideas to life in physical retail spaces.


This role will collaborate with showroom managers, sales teams, and the broader marketing department to help ensure consistency in brand messaging and execution across all retail\-facing touchpoints.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Assist in the coordination and delivery of in\-store marketing materials, including signage, POP displays, brochures, and retail toolkits
* Support the rollout of new product launches by ensuring timely distribution of assets to showroom locations
* Collaborate with the creative team to request and review content for showroom events, campaigns, and merchandising updates
* Work with sales and showroom leadership to understand local marketing needs and help execute programs to support them
* Help plan and support seasonal promotions, showroom events, and grand openings
* Track and report on local marketing campaign performance, showroom engagement, and promotional outcomes
* Coordinate with vendors and internal stakeholders to meet production and delivery deadlines for printed and digital materials
* Maintain accurate records of marketing inventory, showroom displays, and campaign calendars
* Conduct occasional showroom visits to support event execution and brand compliance

 **Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field
* 3–4 years of professional experience in retail, channel, or field marketing\-preferably in a consumer\-facing or showroom\-based environment
* Strong project coordination skills and attention to detail
* Ability to manage timelines and communicate effectively across multiple departments
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint) and basic knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite or Canva
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment with shifting priorities
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Passion for design, branding, and retail marketing
* Occasional travel to showroom locations required

 **Nice to Have**

* Familiarity with merchandising or retail operations
* Experience supporting marketing campaigns or store events
* Exposure to omni\-channel marketing or digital\-to\-store integrations
* Interest in home improvement, design, or building materials space

 **Why Join Us**


At Bedrosians, you'll contribute to bringing our brand to life where customers interact with it most\-on the showroom floor. You'll gain experience across multiple departments while helping create compelling and consistent retail experiences that support both national campaigns and local needs.
