jobs.title: Account Manager, Technical
jobs.description:
At T\-Mobile, we invest in YOU! Our Total Rewards Package ensures that employees get the same big love we give our customers. All team members receive a competitive base salary and compensation package \- this is Total Rewards. Employees enjoy multiple wealth\-building opportunities through our annual stock grant, employee stock purchase plan, 401(k), and access to free, year\-round money coaches. That’s how we’re UNSTOPPABLE for our employees!


Job Overview  

Contribute to T\-Mobile success by ensuring an outstanding Customer Experience. Utilizes expertise and leadership skills to direct team members and to resolve issues to ensure requirements are met. Communicates with end\-users to provide timely and accurate information and status updates. Help streamline operations when customers have service impacting challenges that need specialized support to enhance the overall customer experience for assigned strategic business customers. Collaborates effectively with cross\-functional business and technology development teams to solve problems and ensure customers have the best business solutions.**Job Responsibilities**:* Monitor progress toward resolution of customer problems. Initiates measures to maintain progress toward resolution of impairment/outages such as ticket tracking, resource assignment, escalations, engaging higher tier engineers and scheduling meetings/conference calls if required. Review reporting data to identify performance trends and opportunities. Facilitate quality and customer satisfaction goals to ensure customer retention and uphold the T\-Mobile brand by providing real time support.
* Analyze process flow and application of tools to identify and implement improvements that promote a painless customer experience.
* Ability to effectively acquire the right resources to apply toward resolution of sensitive or chronic troubles. Minimize and contain escalations by demonstrating helpful customer interactions and follow\-up skills.
* Provide timely feedback to the management team on customer trends, issues and needs.

  

**Education and Work Experience**:* High School Diploma/GED (Required)
* 2\-4 years \- Managing Technical Porjects
* Less than 2 years \- Reporting Experience

  

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**:* Business Planning Effective matrix management skills to influence/escalate for commitments when engaging fix actions. (Required)
* Task Management Strong multi\-tasking skills as well as prioritization of activities to resolve several customer emergencies at the same time. (Required)
* Product Knowledge Solid understanding of customer technologies and all Sprint products and services in order to understand and meet customer requirements. Extensive knowledge of T\-Mobile products and services for effective customer management. (Required)
* Root Cause Analysis Ability to interpret service performance for root cause analysis and corrective action. (Required)
* Communication Demonstrates strong business writing techniques and presentation skills on multiple levels including Customer, Vendor, and Executive.. (Required)
* MS Office Suite Proficient in MS Office \- specifically Excel, Word, Power Point, Visio (Required)
* Presentations Ability to present information to all levels of management up to and including the Executive level for both internal and external customers (Required)

  

**Licenses and Certifications**:* At least 18 years of age
* Legally authorized to work in the United States

  

**Travel**:  

Travel Required (Yes/No): Yes  

  

**DOT Regulated**:  

DOT Regulated Position (Yes/No): No  

Safety Sensitive Position (Yes/No): No

**Title: Account Manager** **Associate** **\- Commercial Lines**

**Remote:** for California residents, Los Angeles County area (strongly preferred)  

**Supporting:** IOA \- Los Angeles **\| Book Focus:** Generalist \| **Required:** active P\&C license  

  

*Please note: If this position is posted as either fully remote and/or hybrid, in accordance with company policy, individuals residing within a 50\-mile radius of a branch location may be required to work onsite in a hybrid capacity as there may be occasions when on\-site presence is necessary to meet specific business needs. Additionally, our remote work policy includes having a dedicated, distraction\-free workspace.* *Remote work is not a substitute for childcare, elder care, or other personal responsibilities during working hours.* *To view our branch locations, please visit: ioausa.com/locations*

 **About the Role****:** Provide administrative and customer service support to the account team, Producer, and/or assigned group of accounts. Work with minimal direction from an Account Manager (AM), Account Executive (AE), or Producer, ensuring production and quality standards are met while safeguarding against liability associated with errors and omissions. Independently resolve moderately complex customer service problems and manage smaller\-sized accounts or those with less complexity.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Technical Competence**: Maintain technical competence and industry expertise.
* **Team Leadership:** Assist in directing day\-to\-day activities and workflow of Team Support/Receptionist, Account Assistant, and/or Account Associate.
* **Customer Service**: Handle customer service requests, policy administration, billing, claims, and coverage analysis.
* **Policy Management**: Manage policy expirations and renewals.
* **Renewal Process:** Conduct client research, gather underwriting information, perform loss run analysis, prepare submissions, evaluate and negotiate coverages and pricing, prepare and present proposals, bind coverage, and follow up for policy issuance.

Academy Fire Life Safety offers national one\-stop fire and life safety services through our network of self\-perform districts and trusted vendor partners. Our experienced account managers ensure clients across the country receive the same quality service for fire safety systems. We combine unmatched industry knowledge and scale with personal service and accountability.
  
  

Join our team with over 80 years in business and two decades serving hundreds of national and regional account customers. Academy Fire offers unparalleled expertise in the management of multi\-site fire and life safety protection. Through our customer service centers in New York and California, we provide coverage 24/7, 365 days a year.
  
  

Benefits of joining Academy Fire Life Safety
  
  

**When you join Academy Fire you will receive:**  

* Competitive compensation
* Pay is on a weekly cycle, every Friday
* Career Advancement Opportunities
* Competitive benefits, including healthcare, dental, vision, life insurance, paid time off and holidays
* Company paid short and long\-term disability
* Immediately vested in our 401(k) company match
* Full\-time employees participate in our Shared Ownership Program which offers a monetary bonus aligned to the company's long\-term success. This program fosters an ownership mindset and ensures that every employee meaningfully shares in the success they help create.
* Exceptional guidance and support from our managers
* Collaborative culture \& environment
* Opportunity to work alongside some of the best talent in the fire protection industry

jobs.title: Shopify E-Commerce Specialist (SEO & Digital Marketing)
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

We are is seeking a hands\-on **Shopify E\-Commerce Specialist** to support and grow our direct\-to\-consumer (DTC) e\-commerce business.

Our company currently has an established Amazon business and is expanding our Shopify independent website as an important sales and brand\-building channel.

We are looking for someone who can **independently handle the day\-to\-day operation and optimization of a Shopify store**, including product management, SEO, keyword research, digital advertising, email marketing, website optimization, and performance analysis.

This is a hands\-on execution role. The ideal candidate should be comfortable actually working inside Shopify, Google, Meta, Klaviyo, and other e\-commerce platforms rather than only coordinating with agencies or outside vendors.

**Responsibilities**

Shopify Store Operations

* Independently manage the daily operation of our Shopify store
* Create and update products, collections, pricing, promotions, bundles, and website content
* Optimize product pages, collection pages, landing pages, and navigation
* Manage Shopify apps and integrations
* Update homepage banners, promotional content, and seasonal campaigns
* Improve mobile and desktop shopping experiences
* Monitor website issues and troubleshoot basic Shopify problems
* Coordinate product launches and promotional campaigns
* Implement upselling, cross\-selling, bundles, and other strategies to improve sales
* Continuously improve website conversion and overall customer experience

SEO \& Keyword Optimization

* Conduct keyword research for products, collections, landing pages, and website content
* Identify high\-value and relevant search terms
* Optimize product titles, descriptions, URLs, meta titles, meta descriptions, headings, images, and alt text
* Improve internal linking and website structure
* Optimize product and collection pages for Google search
* Monitor organic traffic, keyword rankings, impressions, clicks, and CTR
* Identify and fix basic technical SEO issues
* Monitor indexing and coverage through Google Search Console
* Conduct competitor keyword and SEO research
* Support content and blog development based on search demand

Experience with **SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, or similar SEO tools** is preferred.

Google Ads \& Google Shopping

* Create, monitor, and optimize Google Ads campaigns
* Assist with Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and remarketing campaigns
* Conduct paid\-search keyword research
* Monitor search terms and negative keywords
* Manage and optimize Google Merchant Center product feeds
* Troubleshoot product\-feed errors and disapprovals
* Monitor advertising performance including ROAS, CPA, CPC, CTR, and conversions
* Adjust campaigns based on performance data

Meta Ads

* Create and optimize Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns
* Assist with prospecting and retargeting campaigns
* Manage audiences and product catalog campaigns
* Monitor Meta Pixel and conversion tracking
* Test advertising creatives, copy, audiences, and offers
* Track ROAS, CPA, CTR, conversion rate, and other performance metrics
* Identify opportunities to improve advertising efficiency

Email \& SMS Marketing

* Manage email and SMS marketing through **Klaviyo**
* Create and send promotional email campaigns
* Build and optimize automated flows, including Welcome, Abandoned Cart, Browse Abandonment, Post\-Purchase, Cross\-Sell, and Win\-Back flows
* Create customer segments for targeted marketing
* Monitor open rates, click rates, conversion rates, and email\-generated revenue
* Assist with customer retention and repeat\-purchase strategies

Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)

* Monitor and improve website conversion rate
* Analyze customer behavior and identify areas where customers drop off
* Optimize product pages, landing pages, cart experience, and calls\-to\-action
* Test different layouts, product messaging, images, promotions, bundles, and offers
* Assist with A/B testing
* Use data to recommend and implement website improvements

Analytics \& Reporting

Work with platforms including:

**Shopify Analytics**  Google Analytics 4 (GA4\) **Google Search Console**  Google Merchant Center **Google Ads**  Meta Ads Manager **Klaviyo**  SEMrush / Ahrefs **Amazon**

Monitor key performance indicators including:

* Website Traffic
* Organic Traffic
* Sales Revenue
* Conversion Rate (CVR)
* Average Order Value (AOV)
* Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
* Cost Per Acquisition (CPA)
* Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
* Click\-Through Rate (CTR)
* Keyword Rankings
* Email/SMS Performance
* Repeat Purchase Rate

The candidate should be comfortable analyzing data and using it to make practical improvements to the website and marketing campaigns.

Amazon Support

Our company currently operates an established Amazon sales channel while expanding our Shopify DTC business.

This position will primarily focus on **Shopify and DTC growth**, but may also assist with Amazon\-related work when needed.

Responsibilities may include:

* Updating Amazon product listings
* Keyword research and listing optimization
* Assisting with Amazon Advertising
* Reviewing Amazon sales and advertising performance
* Coordinating product information and promotions between Amazon and Shopify
* Using successful Amazon products and keyword data to support Shopify growth

Experience with **Amazon Seller Central and Amazon Advertising** is preferred but not required.

Qualifications

* 2\+ years of e\-commerce or digital marketing experience preferred
* Hands\-on Shopify experience
* Experience operating or supporting a DTC e\-commerce website
* Knowledge of SEO and keyword research
* Familiarity with Google Analytics 4 (GA4\)
* Familiarity with Google Search Console
* Familiarity with Google Merchant Center
* Experience with Google Ads and/or Meta Ads
* Experience with Klaviyo or similar email marketing platforms
* Understanding of Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
* Ability to analyze websit

**Job Overview**

We are looking for a “doer” who can take an idea and turn it into content, a campaign, and ultimately new customers. Dedicated and sincere Type A team member.  
We are looking for a **creative, tech\-savvy, results\-oriented Digital Marketing \& Social Media Creator** to help grow our Montessori Preschool and Tutoring Academy and Business.

This is a **hybrid role** combining social media management, digital marketing, content creation, advertising, and day\-to\-day digital support.

We are seeking a dynamic and innovative Hybrid Digital Marketing \& Social Media Creator to elevate our brand presence across multiple digital platforms. This role combines strategic content creation, social media management, and digital campaign execution to engage audiences and drive measurable results. The ideal candidate is passionate about digital marketing trends, skilled in content development, and proficient in leveraging various advertising tools to maximize reach and impact. Join us to craft compelling narratives, optimize campaigns for performance, and contribute to our growth in a fast\-paced, creative environment.

**Duties**

* Develop and implement engaging social media strategies across platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and Tiktok to increase brand awareness and audience engagement.
* Create high\-quality visual content using Canva and graphic design principles that align with brand identity.
* Manage website content and updates through WordPress or other content management systems to ensure fresh, relevant information.
* Plan, execute, and optimize paid advertising campaigns using Google Ads, Facebook Advertising, SEM (Search Engine Marketing), and paid search marketing techniques.
* Conduct keyword research and utilize SEO tools to enhance organic visibility; optimize website content for SEO best practices.
* Monitor campaign performance through web analytics reporting tools like Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager; analyze data to inform ongoing strategy adjustments.
* Coordinate email marketing campaigns using marketing automation platforms to nurture leads and maintain customer engagement.
* Implement conversion optimization strategies by analyzing user behavior data to improve landing pages and call\-to\-actions for better results.
* Track digital marketing metrics regularly to evaluate campaign success; prepare comprehensive reports on web analytics and marketing performance.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams on digital campaign setup, content management, and social media advertising campaigns to ensure cohesive messaging.

**Skills**

jobs.description:
**Position Summary**



The Client Relationship Manager is responsible for delivering an exceptional customer experience while supporting the day\-to\-day operations of View Cleaners. This role combines customer relationship management, retail store leadership, administrative support, team coaching, client retention, and business development.



As the primary point of contact for clients, the Client Relationship Manager ensures that every customer interaction reflects View Cleaners' commitment to luxury garment care, professionalism, and personalized service. This position also supports home delivery clients, retail operations, marketing initiatives, team communications, and administrative functions. The role combines responsibilities from both retail management and administrative leadership functions.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Client Experience \& Relationship Management**


* Build strong relationships with retail and home delivery clients.
* Ensure every customer is greeted promptly, professionally, and courteously.
* Resolve client concerns, service issues, and garment claims quickly and professionally.
* Follow up with customers regarding delayed orders, special requests, and satisfaction concerns.
* Develop and maintain relationships with VIP, concierge, and high\-value clients.
* Increase client retention through personalized service and proactive communication.
* Generate referral business and positive online reviews.


**Retail Store Operations**


* Oversee daily operations of the retail location.
* Ensure all garments are processed accurately and ready when promised.
* Maintain a clean, organized, and professional store environment.
* Reconcile cash drawers and verify daily deposits.
* Monitor workflow between retail stores, production plant, and delivery routes.
* Maintain operational reports and performance metrics.

**Team Leadership \& Development**


* Train, coach, and mentor Customer Service Representatives.
* Conduct onboarding for new team members.
* Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Create schedules and manage timekeeping records.

* Conduct daily huddles and team communication meetings.

**Administrative \& Office Support**


* Answer client emails, phone calls, and online inquiries.
* Support payroll preparation and administrative record keeping.
* Assist with HR documentation and compliance.
* Coordinate meetings, training schedules, and internal communications.
* Maintain organized digital and physical records.
* Support management with special projects and reporting.


**Marketing \& Business Development**


* Support implementation of marketing campaigns.
* Assist with social media engagement and customer outreach.
* Promote View Cleaners' Home \& Office Pickup and Delivery Service.
* Support customer loyalty and referral programs.
* Identify opportunities to increase sales and client engagement.
* Help strengthen View Cleaners' reputation as Orange County's premier garment care provider.


**Key Competencies**


* Exceptional customer service and relationship\-building skills
* Strong verbal and written communication
* Leadership and coaching abilities
* Professional conflict resolution
* Organizational and project management skills
* Attention to detail
* Problem\-solving mindset
* Positive attitude and professionalism
* Ability to multitask in a fast\-paced environment
* Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office, POS systems, CRM software, and email platforms


**Preferred**


* Dry cleaning, hospitality, luxury retail, or service industry experience
* Experience managing customer relationships and teams
* Knowledge of garment care and textile services


**About View Cleaners**



View Cleaners is Orange County's premier dry cleaning and laundry service, serving customers since 1976\. We specialize in luxury garment care, wedding gowns, designer apparel, household items, and complimentary home and office pickup and delivery service. Our mission is to provide world\-class customer experience through exceptional service, attention to detail, and lasting client relationships.


**Core Values:**


* Customer First
* Accountability
* Integrity
* Continuous Improvement
* Teamwork
* Excellence in Service


This position is ideal for someone who enjoys building relationships, leading people, solving problems, and helping grow a high\-end service business.

jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative – B2B Appointment Setting
jobs.description:
**Location:** Irvine, CA

**Job Type:** Part\-Time (with opportunity to transition to Full\-Time)

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, approximately 4 hours per day (16–20 hours/week)

**Pay:** $18–$20/hour (based on experience) \+ Performance Bonus \+ Commission

**About Us**

We are an Irvine\-based company providing Advertising \& Marketing, Commercial Signage, Branding, Printing, Video Production, and Trade Show Exhibit solutions to businesses throughout Southern California.

We are looking for an energetic and persistent B2B Inside Sales / Appointment Setter who is comfortable making outbound calls, speaking with business owners and decision\-makers, and developing new sales opportunities.

The core of this position is simple:

Call → Reach the Decision Maker → Identify Needs → Qualify the Opportunity → Schedule an Appointment → Follow Up

Qualified opportunities will be supported by our Sales and Project teams through proposals, site visits, and closing.

**Key Responsibilities**

1\. Make outbound calls to prospective business clients using company\-provided lead lists and market resources.

2\. Use phone, email, LinkedIn, and other channels to initiate conversations with potential B2B clients.

3\. Connect with business owners, managers, marketing teams, operations managers, property managers, and other relevant decision\-makers.

4\. Introduce our services, including:

(1\) Advertising \& Marketing

(2\) Social Media \& Content Creation

(3\) Video Production

(4\) Commercial Signage

(5\) Storefront \& Lobby Signs

(6\) Interior Branding \& Wall Graphics

(7\) Commercial Printing \& Event Displays

(8\) Trade Show Booths \& Exhibits

5\. Identify potential needs such as new business openings, signage projects, renovations, rebranding, marketing campaigns, social media content, events, and trade shows.

6\. Qualify potential opportunities and schedule phone calls, Zoom meetings, client meetings, or site visits for the Sales team.

7\. Maintain accurate records of conversations, client needs, and follow\-up status.

8\. Consistently follow up with previous leads and identify new sales opportunities.

**Qualifications**

1\. Comfortable with Cold Calling and speaking with new business prospects.

2\. Strong English speaking and telephone communication skills.

3\. Experience in Telesales, Inside Sales, Telemarketing, Appointment Setting, Customer Service, or Business Development is preferred.

4\. Persistent and comfortable following up multiple times when appropriate.

5\. Self\-motivated and able to work toward clear activity and sales goals.

6\. B2B Sales, Advertising, Marketing, Signage, Printing, Trade Show, Event, or related industry experience is a plus.

**Compensation \& Schedule**

**Starting Position:** Part\-Time

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday

**Hours:** Approximately 16–20 hours per week

**Base Pay:** $18–$20/hour, depending on experience

**Additional Compensation:** Performance\-Based Bonus \+ Sales Commission

Additional compensation may be earned based on qualified opportunities, appointments, and closed sales.

**How We Measure Success**

We care about call activity, but results matter more than simply making a high number of calls.

Performance will be evaluated based on the sales pipeline you help create:

Meaningful Conversations → Qualified Leads → Appointments → Quotes → Closed Sales

**Who We're Looking For**

We are not looking for someone who simply wants to complete a daily call quota.

We want someone who is comfortable picking up the phone, starting conversations with new businesses, following up consistently, and turning cold prospects into real sales opportunities.

This is not a passive customer service position.

If you enjoy talking to people, aren't afraid of cold calling, and want the opportunity to increase your income through performance, we'd like to hear from you.

Pay: $18\.00 \- $20\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 16\.0 – 20\.0 per week

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Irvine, CA 92612

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Overview**


Since our founding in 1924, we've cut cardiovascular disease deaths in half, but there is still so much more to do. To overcome today’s biggest health challenges and accelerate this progress, we need passionate individuals like you. Join our movement, be part of the progress, and help ensure a healthier future for all. You matter, and so does the impact you can make with us.


The American Heart Association has an excellent opportunity for a Project Coordinator in our Quality, Outcome Research, \& Analytics (QORA) department!


This is a full\-time, benefits\-eligible, grant\-funded opportunity. Current funding will expire April 1, 2027 with the possibility of extension.


This position can be home\-based.


The Association offers many resources to help you maintain work\-life harmonization through your changing needs and life situations. To help you be successful, you will have access to Heart U, our award\-winning corporate university, as well as additional training and support, locally.


\#TheAHALife is more than a company culture; it is our way of life. It embodies our commitment to work\-life harmonization and is guided by our core values where our employees can thrive both personally and professionally. Discover why you will Be Seen. Be Heard. Be Valued at the American Heart Association by following us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, and at heart.jobs.


**Responsibilities**


The Project Coordinator supports the successful execution of health sciences research and measure development initiatives through project coordination, administrative support, stakeholder engagement, and program operations. Working closely with internal staff, subject matter experts, researchers, and external partners, this role coordinates meetings and activities, maintains project documentation and databases, supports reporting efforts, and ensures smooth day\-to\-day operations.


* Support day\-to\-day operations of initiatives, including scheduling internal, external, and cross\-functional meetings, managing agendas, capturing notes and action items, tracking follow\-up activities, coordinating materials, and maintaining project documentation.
* Develop, input, and maintain information in project tracking systems, databases, SharePoint sites, and other software platforms.
* Handle administrative and financial tasks, including processing invoices, tracking budgets and expenses, and supporting contract and grant administration activities.
* Support virtual meeting logistics and technology setup.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for project participants, subject matter experts, and external partners, coordinating communications, responding to inquiries, and assisting with onboarding activities.
* Prepare and maintain project documentation, status reports, meeting summaries, dashboards, stakeholder updates, and other materials aligned with project goals and timelines.
* Assist with the development and dissemination of program materials, templates, reports, and resources.
* Coordinate project timelines, deliverables, and meeting schedules to support successful execution of research and measure development activities.

**Qualifications**


* High School Diploma or equivalent.
* Minimum of three (3\) years of relevant experience that includes administrative and/or project coordination experience.
* Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously and meet specified timelines.
* Administrative expertise with sophisticated clerical responsibilities and data management.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills.
* Effective interpersonal skills with proven ability to develop collaborative working relationships internally and externally.
* Experience coordinating meetings, events, or project activities across multiple stakeholder groups.

**Here are some of the preferred experience and skills we are seeking:**


* Bachelor's degree in health sciences, public health, healthcare administration, research, or a related field.
* Experience supporting health sciences, research, quality improvement, measurement, or healthcare\-related projects.
* Experience working with subject matter experts, researchers, healthcare professionals, or external partners.
* Knowledge of basic data tracking, reporting, or research support processes.

**Proficiency Requirement**


* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint. Experience working with project management, database, or collaboration systems is a plus.

**Compensation \& Benefits**


The expected pay range will be $20\.51 per hour to $25\.64 per hour. Pay is commensurate with experience; geographic differentials to the pay range may apply. The American Heart Association reserves the right to pay more or less than the posted range. The American Heart Association invests in its people. Here are the main components of our total rewards package. Visit Rewards \& Benefits to see more details.


* **Compensation** – Our goal is to ensure you have a competitive base salary. That’s why we regularly review the market value of jobs and make adjustments, as needed.
* **Performance and Recognition** – You are rewarded for achieving success through annual salary planning and incentive programs; eligibility for an incentive program is based on the type of position.
* **Benefits** – We offer a wide array of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance, along with a robust retirement program that includes an employer match and automatic contribution. As a mark of our commitment to employee well\-being, we also offer an employee assistance program, employee wellness program and telemedicine, and medical consultation.

jobs.title: PROGRAM COORDINATOR
jobs.description:
**Help Build the Workplace Behind the Mission**


Come join our team! Homeward Bound helps unsheltered individuals and families in Marin County transform their lives through housing, training, and supportive services.


Homeward Bound is Marin County’s primary provider of shelter and housing for individuals and families experiencing homelessness. We offer emergency shelter, short\- and long\-term supportive housing, job training and placement, and wraparound services. Our mission is **Opening Doors to Safety, Dignity, Hope, and Independence**.


We are seeking a **Program Coordinator** \- Puett Place to join our adult housing team and support residents as they build stability and self\-sufficiency. In this role, you’ll work with participants in our newly opened 24\-unit **veteran** **housing** program, which provides affordable housing for adults transitioning out of homelessness. You will help residents maintain their housing, navigate challenges, and move toward greater independence.

**What You'll Do**

* Provide housing\-focused case management to individuals and groups.
* Coordinate care with healthcare, behavioral health, housing, and community partners.
* Support housing stability through advocacy, referrals, crisis intervention, and conflict resolution.
* Address barriers to housing, income, employment, and health using Housing First and trauma\-informed approaches.
* Maintain regular participant engagement to support progress toward housing goals.
* Assist with housing eligibility, leasing, move\-ins, and housing retention.
* Coordinate voucher paperwork and required housing documentation.
* Support basic property management functions, including maintenance requests, rent tracking, tenancy issues, and site monitoring.
* Collaborate with program leadership to improve housing operations and participant outcomes.
* Provide cross\-program support within the team’s housing book as needed
* Maintain client records and data in HMIS, Salesforce, and other required systems.
* Meet program, funder, and agency documentation standards and deadlines.

**What We're Looking For**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in social work, psychology, human services, or a related field, **or** three (3\) years of experience in housing, residential, or human services.
* Experience working with individuals experiencing homelessness or other underserved populations preferred.
* Knowledge of Housing First, harm reduction, trauma\-informed care, mental health, substance use, and community resources.
* Familiarity with public benefits systems (SSI, SSDI, SDI) and housing programs.
* Experience with HMIS, Salesforce, or similar databases, and proficiency with Microsoft Office and cloud\-based applications.
* Strong communication, organization, documentation, and case management skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a diverse, fast\-paced environment.
* Commitment to equity, inclusion, confidentiality, and professional standards.
**Preferred**

* Experience working with veterans in case management settings
* Compassionate, organized, and solution\-focused.
* Able to work independently and collaboratively.
* Maintains professional boundaries and adapts to changing priorities.
* Committed to supporting housing stability and ending homelessness.
* Sense of humor encouraged
**Why Join Homeward Bound?**


At Homeward Bound, our employees make a tangible difference every day. We believe supporting our team is essential to supporting our community.


We offer:

* 100% employer\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 403(b) retirement plan with discretionary employer match
* Two weeks of paid vacation annually
* Employee Assistance Program
* Complimentary lunch at our administrative site
* A collaborative, mission\-driven workplace where your work has lasting impact

jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

  

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next\-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.

  

  

**What We Offer**

  

Salary:


$88,000\.00 \- $121,000\.00
Location:


Santa Clara,CA
You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.


At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits .


**R** **ole Overview**

We are seeking a Marketing Communications Specialist to support strategic communications and engagement initiatives for Applied Materials' Semiconductor Product Group (SPG) Strategy \& Product Marketing team. This role will support the execution of high\-impact customer events, industry forums, executive engagements, internal communications, and integrated marketing programs that enhance product visibility and strengthen Applied's leadership position in the semiconductor industry. The ideal candidate brings experience in event strategy and execution, vendor and media management, internal communications, and cross\-functional collaboration within a fast\-paced, technology\-driven environment.  

  



**Key Responsibilities**

**Event Strategy \& Execution**

* Support the planning and execution of high\-impact showcase events aligned with major industry gatherings, including large\-format technology forums, regional symposia, customer engagements, expert panels at global conferences and university engagements.
* Coordinate all facets of event execution, including venue identification, vendor engagement (e.g., audiovisual, design, hospitality, transportation, accommodations), contract negotiation, site inspections, and end\-to\-end logistics support.
* Manage event registration, attendee communications, surveys, reporting, and onsite event management through Cvent.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to develop compelling event content and ensure alignment with business objectives and brand messaging.

**Vendor \& Media Management**

* Support the management of external agencies and vendors to produce high\-quality promotional materials.
* Coordinate vendor deliverables, budgets, timelines, and logistics to support program execution.
* Support media outreach activities and recommend appropriate channels to help reach target audiences and maximize campaign impact.

**Internal Communications**

* Develop and distribute internal communications that keep employees informed and engaged, including announcements, newsletters, leadership messages, and event\-related updates.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams—product marketing, sales, and engineering—to ensure consistent, accurate, and timely internal messaging.
* Support the rollout of product launches and company initiatives through clear internal communication plans, maintaining channels and templates that ensure a consistent voice and brand.
* Drive the planning and execution of internal events, including strategy meetings and employee engagement activities.

**Stakeholder Engagement \& Reporting**

* Build and maintain relationships with key internal and external stakeholders, including executives, customers, partners, academia and vendors.
* Track and report on event performance, media engagement, and campaign effectiveness using relevant KPIs and analytics tools.

**Qualifications**

* 4\+ years of experience in marketing communications, product marketing, corporate communications, public relations, event marketing, or a related field.
* Experience supporting large\-scale, multi\-stakeholder events in a technology or B2B environment.
* Proficiency with event management platforms including Cvent, including event setup, registration management, attendee communications, reporting, and analytics.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including internal and executive communications.
* Strong project management and organizational skills.
* Experience in high\-tech industries preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field.

**Competencies**

* Functional Knowledge: Strong understanding of marketing communications, event strategy, and stakeholder engagement.
* Business Expertise: Ability to align communications activities within broader business goals.
* Problem Solving: Effectively manages competing priorities and resolves operational challenges.
* Impact: Drives business results through strategic communications and event execution.
* Interpersonal Skills: Collaborates effectively with cross\-functional teams and external partners.

**Additional Information**

**Time Type:**

Full time
**Employee Type:**

Assignee / Regular
**Travel:**

Yes, 25% of the Time
**Relocation Eligible:**

Yes

In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation such as participation in a bonus and a stock award program, as applicable.

jobs.title: Merchant Sales Account Manager (MSAM)
jobs.description:
**Merchant Sales Account Manager (MSAM)**

**Join Aldelo Pay — Uncapped Commission, Real Growth, No Cold\-Start Chaos**

Are you a driven, self\-motivated sales professional ready to turn your hustle into six figures? Aldelo is looking for a **Merchant Sales Account Manager** to help merchants nationwide save money and run their businesses better — while building a career with uncapped earning potential and real advancement.

This isn't just a sales job. You'll be a trusted advisor to business owners, helping them discover how Aldelo Pay's merchant services, Point of Sale systems, and integrated solutions can boost their bottom line. You'll own the full relationship — from first call to onboarding — backed by a team that has your back every step of the way.

**Why You'll Love This Role**

* **Uncapped Earnings:** $65,000 base salary plus residuals and sales commissions — with no cap. Top performers regularly reach six figures or more.
* **Real Impact:** Help merchants achieve measurable savings and operational efficiency — you're not just closing deals, you're solving real problems.
* **Career Growth:** Build deep product expertise, strengthen cross\-team relationships with our Credit and Risk team, and grow your skills as a trusted merchant advisor.
* **Stability \+ Structure:** A consistent Monday–Friday, 8am–5pm schedule and a supportive team environment in our Pleasanton office.
* **Full Benefits Package:** Medical, Dental, Vision, Paid Time Off, Medical Leave, and Retirement.

**What You'll Do**

As an MSAM, you'll work directly with end\-user merchants by phone and email, representing Aldelo's products and solutions with professionalism and expertise. You'll assess each merchant's business and POS needs to build a compelling, tailored ROI story — then guide them seamlessly through processing, installation, and onboarding onto Aldelo Express Cloud POS.

Success in this role means staying active and engaged: making 120–150 outbound calls a day, pursuing new opportunities, and nurturing lasting relationships with existing clients.

**What We're Looking For**

* Associate's or bachelor's degree
* Strong computer and phone skills
* Detail\-oriented with excellent verbal and written communication
* Comfortable managing 100\+ outbound calls per day
* Reliable, dependable, and a strong team player
* Goals\-driven, sales\-oriented, and self\-directed
* Merchant sales, general sales, or tele\-sales experience strongly preferred

**Position Details**

**Job Title**

Merchant Sales Account Manager (MSAM)

**Job Type**

Full\-Time

**Location**

Pleasanton, CA (6701 Koll Center Parkway, Suite 150, Pleasanton, CA 94566\)

**Schedule**

Monday–Friday, 8am–5pm

**Base Salary**

$65,000/year depending on experience

**Commission**

Residuals \+ sales commissions, uncapped — reach six figures or more

**Benefits**

Medical, Dental, Vision, PTO, Medical Leave, Retirement

**Remote Work**

Not available — daily on\-site commute required

**Ready to Apply?**

Email your resume to **jobs@aldelo.com** with **"MSAM"** in the subject line. We're excited to hear from you!

Pay: $56,710\.85 \- $70,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Describe your experience in merchant services, payments, POS, or a related B2B sales role.
* What was the highest volume of outbound calls you've sustained in a single day or week in a prior role, and for how long?
* Tell me about a time you built a business case or ROI story to convince a skeptical prospect. What was the outcome?
* Tell me about a time you missed a sales target. What did you do differently afterward?

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Ability to Commute:

* Pleasanton, CA 94566 (Required)

Willingness to travel:

* 25% (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager, AWS Enterprise Support, Strategic Industries
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  

  

Would you like to join one of the fastest\-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes including Automotive, Financial Services, Energy, Big Data, and more gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we’re looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application\-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  

The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more.  

Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support and risk management.  

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  

  

  

  

About the team  

About AWS  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3\) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer\-facing environment as a technical lead

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  

The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more.  

Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support and risk management.  

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  

  

  

  

About the team  

About AWS  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3\) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer\-facing environment as a technical lead

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager
jobs.description:
### **G'day!**

We are ServiceRocket , a global tech\-enabled services company headquartered in Palo Alto, California. Our purpose is to be the single most reliable partner in the acceleration of your growth. At ServiceRocket, we are committed to the development of every Rocketeer and the trust of every customer.


Twenty years on and counting, we’ve got your back.


### **Why is ServiceRocket the place for you**

* A 20\+ year tech services expert of many solutions and partnerships with industry giants.
* Our diverse world of Rocketeers lives by our values with a collaborative mindset resulting in a 4\.7 rating on Glassdoor.
* Our culture rocks! You’ll join a fun\-loving and inclusive work environment that supports your professional growth and personal well\-being.
* We're recognized for our innovation, impact, and outstanding customer support, even earning the Atlassian Partner of the Year 2024–2025 for Co\-Selling Excellence award.

Visit our website to learn more and become a part of our Rocketeer Nation.


### **About the Sales and Success area**

ServiceRocket's Sales \& Success team is the commercial engine of the business as they are focused on finding, growing, and retaining customer relationships. Account Managers own the full customer relationship, from strategic account planning and executive engagement through to renewals, expansions, and partner co\-selling, primarily within the Atlassian ecosystem.


They work as the commercial lead in a cross\-functional "trio" alongside Solution Architects and delivery teams, translating customer needs into profitable software and services solutions. We look for self\-starters with commercial curiosity, MEDPICC discipline, and a hunger to grow a book of business.


### **What you’ll be doing**

* Build and maintain lasting relationships with customers and partners by understanding their focus, anticipating their needs, and solving their problems
* Lead XBRs (real\-time QBRs) for high\-value, high\-touch accounts, focusing on strategic alignment and value demonstration
* Develop strategic problem/solution roadmaps that address current and long\-term customer needs
* Generate leads, manage pipeline, update forecasts, and develop and execute account plans
* Perform prospecting activities such as cold calling and networking
* Close opportunities to achieve sales targets
* Deliver partner software quotes and orders, ensuring eligible deals are registered with the appropriate partner program incentives
* Co\-sell with partners by jointly creating services and software solutions that address customer needs
* Follow up with customers regularly to ensure needs are being met and to identify opportunities
* Maintain CRM and account plans for customers and prospects (HubSpot and NetSuite)
* Coordinate internal and external resources — including Licensing, Services, Solution Architecture, RevOps, Marketing, Finance, and Legal — to improve customers' experience
* Host product demonstrations, webinars, and other online events to educate customers and prospects
* Illustrate the value of ServiceRocket's products and services to create growth opportunities
* Stay current with ServiceRocket's offerings and industry trends
### **What you bring to the table ‍**

* 7\+ years of experience in an account management or sales role
* Proven track record of meeting or exceeding targets
* MEDPICC discipline and ability to qualify, progress, and forecast opportunities with clear evidence
* Experience managing commercial conversations with multiple stakeholders — champions, economic buyers, procurement, and executive sponsors
* Deep knowledge of Atlassian's product suite and strong understanding of the enterprise software landscape
* Advanced skills in full\-cycle sales, strategic planning, negotiation, and stakeholder management
* Proven ability to work autonomously and grow a book of business
* Strong communication skills and executive presence — you Talk Straight and build trust quickly
* Experience with CRM discipline and deal documentation; HubSpot and NetSuite experience preferred
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field

### **What We Look For in Sales Rocketeers ✨**

This role is a key member of our sales team, focused on finding and driving both short and long\-term opportunities. You ideally have experience in solution selling, using products such as Atlassian to drive transformational services solutions to customers. Beyond the role requirements, our Sales leadership looks for:
* **Self\-starters** who take initiative, follow through, and own their pipeline without waiting to be directed
* **Hungry and resilient** individuals motivated by goals, comfortable with ambiguity, and proactive about creating opportunities
* **Commercial curiosity** — a genuine interest in understanding customer problems and connecting those needs to ServiceRocket solutions
* **Collaborative sellers** who can work across Customer Success, Solution Engineers, Licensing, Services, and partner teams to create customer outcomes
* **Software sales interest or experience** — SaaS, enterprise software, or Atlassian ecosystem experience is highly preferred but not mandatory when strong sales fundamentals are present
* **Process discipline** — CRM hygiene, qualification frameworks, and forecast accuracy matter here
### **Your leaders**

Kharisma is a volleyball enthusiast, an animal rescue advocate, and our fearless sales leader. With 20\+ years of go\-to\-market leadership, she leads our Global Sales team across four continents with sharp instincts, execution discipline, and a genuine belief in collaborative partnerships. With her and Rob, our founder and CEO, you'll co\-sell with world\-class partners, grow high\-value customer relationships, and sharpen your craft in a team that leads through delighting the customer!  

  

The expectation of office attendance for this hybrid role is 2 times a week at our Palo Alto office.
### **Perks ✨**

* **Share the fruit program** **:** when we grow

jobs.title: Outside Sales Account Manager
jobs.description:
**JOB SUMMARY:** 

This position is to sell Shimadzu Medical Systems USA California Branch product line and services. Customers may include businesses, governmental organizations, and individuals. Sales executives approach potential customers with the aim of winning new business, as well as maintaining good relationships with clients while achieving maximum profitability and growth in line with the company mission and values.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

1\. Assists in the development and implementation of marketing plans as needed.

* Listening to customer needs and presenting appropriate solutions to make a sale.
* Maintaining and developing relationships with existing customers in person and via telephone calls and emails.
* Calling to arrange meetings with ALL customers in assigned territories for current and potential new business on all product lines; Contact with each customer should be a minimum of once per year.
* Timely responding to incoming email and phone enquiries.
* Acting as a contact between a company and its existing and potential markets.
* Negotiating the terms of an agreement and closing sales.
* Gathering market and customer information.
* Representing their company at trade exhibitions, events and demonstrations.
* Challenging any objections with a view to getting the customer to buy.
* Creating detailed proposal documents, often as part of a formal bidding process which is largely dictated by the prospective customer.
* Reviewing your own sales performance, aiming to meet or exceed targets.
* Gaining a clear understanding of customers' businesses and requirements.
* Making accurate, rapid cost calculations and providing customers with quotations.
* Feeding future buying trends back to employers.
* Attending team meetings and sharing best practices with colleagues.

17\. Provides timely feedback to sales manager regarding performance.

18\. Provides timely, accurate, competitive pricing on all completed prospect applications submitted for pricing and approval, while striving to maintain maximum profit margin.

19\. Maintains accurate records of all pricings, sales, and activity reports.

20\. Creates and conducts proposal presentations.

21\. Controls expenses to meet budget guidelines.

22\. Adheres to all company policies, procedures and business ethics codes and ensures that they are communicated and implemented within the team.

23\. Meets product mix goals set by senior management.

24\. Attending sales meetings or gatherings representing SMS gathering new information on products and marketplace and sharing best practice with colleagues. Responsible for educating sales staff on any new information or marketplace changes.

25\. Maintains real\-time data in sales force system, including an accurate 30/60/90 monthly forecast. Will meet with NDS monthly to review forecast.

26\. Sells service contract at POS (Point of Sales) of equipment.

27\. Develops strategic partnership with target key accounts and IDNs in the territory for both products and services revenue increase, including the partnership contract negotiation.

**Internal / External Cooperation**

1\. Develops customer relationships to be used as show sites or reference sites.

2\. Maintains contact with all clients in the market area to ensure high levels of client satisfaction.

3\. Demonstrates ability to interact and cooperate with all company employees.

4\. Demonstrates behaviors consistent with the Company’s Mission and Values in all interactions with customers, co\-workers and suppliers.

5\. Establishes and maintains effective working relationships based on Trust, Respect, and Cooperation with managers, co\-workers, customers and vendors.

6\. Complies with all customer and company policies, procedures and safety standards

7\. Performs all duties in a professional and courteous manner, respectful customer’s needs and patient privacy.

**Skills, Experience, and Job Requirements:**

1\. High School diploma or GED required bachelor’s degree preferred

2\. 5 years business to business outside sales experience preferably in medical imaging capital equipment sales

3\. Entrepreneurial attitude

4\. Proven track record of successfully closing new business

5\. Excellent negotiation \& closing skills

6\. Willingness to travel up to 40\-50% (at least once a week)

7\. Valid driver’s license and is insurable.

8\. Advanced computer skills with knowledge of Microsoft Windows applications.

9\. Excellent verbal and written English skills.

10\. Ability to synthesize complex issues and communicate in simple messages

11\. Good organization skills, applies high level of attention to detail and accuracy.

12\. Quality and customer service driven to consistently meet/exceed INTERNAL or EXTERNAL customer expectations.

13\. Team player who is willing to go above and beyond to help others.

14\. Good time management skills, can work independently with minimal supervision.

Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $90,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible schedule
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Account Manager - Commercial Lines (California)
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

**Title:****A****ccount Manager \- Commercial Lines**  

**Hybrid Preferred:**Southern California (Aliso Viejo, Los Angeles County, Ontario, San Diego, or Santa Barbara)  

**Remote:** California residents  

**Book Focus:**Generalist and/or Construction \| **Required:** active property \& casualty (P\&C) license  

  

*Please note: If this position is posted as either fully remote and/or hybrid, in accordance with company policy, individuals residing within a 50\-mile radius of a branch location may be required to work onsite in a hybrid capacity as there may be occasions when on\-site presence is necessary to meet specific business needs. Additionally, our remote work policy includes having a dedicated, distraction\-free workspace.**Remote work is not a substitute for childcare, elder care, or other personal responsibilities during working hours.**To view our branch locations, please visit: ioausa.com/locations*

**About the Role****:** Manage an assigned book of business, ensuring account retention and supporting new business. Coordinate day\-to\-day administrative and customer service activities, resolving complex issues, and ensuring no errors or omissions.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Technical Competence**: Maintain technical competence and industry expertise.
* **Team Leadership**: Direct daily activities of the account management team.
* **Customer Service**: Handle customer service requests, policy administration, billing, claims, and coverage analysis.
* **Policy Management**: Manage policy expirations and renewals.
* **Renewal Process**: Conduct client research, prepare submissions, negotiate coverages, and present proposals.
* **Accounts Receivable**: Monitor reports and take action on delinquent accounts, collecting outstanding balances.
* **System Maintenance**: Maintain agency management systems and carrier/vendor platforms, ensuring data accuracy and completeness.
* **Activity Monitoring:** Monitor and maintain activity/suspense to ensure timely completion.
* **Communication:** Maintain frequent, transparent communication with the account team regarding workload status and any issues.
* **Service Excellence:** Deliver excellent service, proactively anticipate needs, and respond quickly to service requests.
* **Policy Compliance:** Stay updated on company policies and procedures.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Seek and adopt best practices to improve individual and team performance.
* **Champion IOA Values:** Demonstrate integrity and leadership.
  

  

**Ideal Candidate****Qualifications:**

* 3\-5 years of account management experience, or 5\+ years in the insurance industry
* Thorough knowledge of insurance brokerage and client needs
* Required active property \& casualty (P\&C) licensing; professional designation (CIC or equivalent) preferred
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills
* Exceptional customer service, communication, multitasking, and organizational skills
* Proficiency in MS Office (Outlook, Word, Excel)
* High School Diploma (or equivalent)
  

  

**What We Offer:**

* Competitive salaries and bonus potential
* Company\-paid health insurance
* Paid holidays, vacations, and sick time
* 401K with employer match
* Professional growth and career progression opportunities
* Respectful culture and work/family life balance
* Community service commitment
* Supportive teammates and a rewarding work environment
  

  

**What to Expect****(Application Process)****:**

* 30\-Minute Phone Screen, Online Assessments, and Interview(s)
**Salary Range**


The expected pay range for this position is $80,000\.00 \- $105,000\.00 annually depending on experience, relevant skills, and geographic location.


Insurance Office of America is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Account Manager, CPG
jobs.description:
**About the Team**
------------------



The Enterprise Ad Sales Team is responsible for the marketing vision, development and growth of our largest advertising partnerships. This team was recently formed, and is seeking additional founding team members to build an industry\-leading ads and promotions business across DoorDash's core categories, starting with enterprise restaurant and consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands. The growing DoorDash ads business will quickly become the single best place for merchants and brands to market to local customers, in an ecosystem that benefits all parties.



You'll leverage AI\-powered insights, data\-driven signals, and emerging tools to shape strategy, inform decision\-making, identify opportunities, and drive growth across complex, enterprise\-level engagements. By integrating AI and data\-enabled analysis into day\-to\-day workflows, you'll improve prioritization, execution, and business impact while partnering cross\-functionally to translate evolving platform and AI capabilities into clear, tangible value for partners and the business.


**About the Role**
------------------



The Account Manager, CPG will steer the company's efforts in adopting and partnering with major CPGs across our grocery, convenience, restaurant and retail markets. Digital grocery and convenience is expanding, and DoorDash is making meaningful strides to become a leader in this sector. You will build partnerships that create tangible value for both DoorDash and advertisers. In this role, you will manage the ads strategy across a focused portfolio of accounts, and drive adoption of our growing ads and promotions offering. You will also work cross\-functionally with account executives, marketing, analytics, and product to innovate on our future approach and solutions. You will report into a CPG Industry Manager in our Enterprise Sales \& Business Development organization.


**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------


* Be part of the growing DoorDash Ads \& Promos team
* Lead end\-to\-end marketing conversations across a portfolio of consumer packaged goods (CPG) advertisers
* Oversee the strategy for engaging with and selling to our largest partners
* Steer the development, adoption and scaling of CPG revenue
* Build a marketing calendar with CPG partners in your book of business
* Develop long\-term business plans alongside our partners for their multi\-channel customer strategies
* Maintain pitch decks and sales content to help produce new business opportunities
* Create marketing campaigns; own post\-campaign reporting
* Work with partners across DoorDash to align companywide resources to help build\-out our partners' digital businesses

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------


* You have 3\-6 years of cross\-functional operational experience

Impact Motivated * \- You have a natural desire to improve the overall business

Curious * \- You love digging into low levels of detail to extract insights

Strategic * \- You love to find the win\-win in novel agreement structures to grow business with partners

Diverse * \- You are happy juggling many priorities concurrently
* Bachelor's degree required, MBA or Masters Degree a plus
* Prior investment banking, consulting or equity research experience
* Business Development and Partnerships experience
* Experience with Analytics and Presentation tools
* You have proficiency in analytics and visualization tools (e.g., Snowflake, Sigma, etc.)
* Experience leveraging data, AI\-informed insights, and emerging AI tools to drive strategic decisions, enhance productivity, and improve outcomes in complex business environments.
* Strong ability to interpret AI\-generated insights, synthesize them into clear, actionable recommendations and executive\-level narratives, and influence stakeholders.
* Baseline fluency in AI concepts, with a willingness to continuously learn and adopt new technologies as AI capabilities become increasingly embedded in workflows, products, and customer interactions.

**About DoorDash**
------------------



At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door\-to\-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.  

  

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.


**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
---------------------------------------------



We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.
