jobs.title: Account Manager, Technical
jobs.description:
At T\-Mobile, we invest in YOU! Our Total Rewards Package ensures that employees get the same big love we give our customers. All team members receive a competitive base salary and compensation package \- this is Total Rewards. Employees enjoy multiple wealth\-building opportunities through our annual stock grant, employee stock purchase plan, 401(k), and access to free, year\-round money coaches. That’s how we’re UNSTOPPABLE for our employees!


Job Overview  

Contribute to T\-Mobile success by ensuring an outstanding Customer Experience. Utilizes expertise and leadership skills to direct team members and to resolve issues to ensure requirements are met. Communicates with end\-users to provide timely and accurate information and status updates. Help streamline operations when customers have service impacting challenges that need specialized support to enhance the overall customer experience for assigned strategic business customers. Collaborates effectively with cross\-functional business and technology development teams to solve problems and ensure customers have the best business solutions.**Job Responsibilities**:* Monitor progress toward resolution of customer problems. Initiates measures to maintain progress toward resolution of impairment/outages such as ticket tracking, resource assignment, escalations, engaging higher tier engineers and scheduling meetings/conference calls if required. Review reporting data to identify performance trends and opportunities. Facilitate quality and customer satisfaction goals to ensure customer retention and uphold the T\-Mobile brand by providing real time support.
* Analyze process flow and application of tools to identify and implement improvements that promote a painless customer experience.
* Ability to effectively acquire the right resources to apply toward resolution of sensitive or chronic troubles. Minimize and contain escalations by demonstrating helpful customer interactions and follow\-up skills.
* Provide timely feedback to the management team on customer trends, issues and needs.

  

**Education and Work Experience**:* High School Diploma/GED (Required)
* 2\-4 years \- Managing Technical Porjects
* Less than 2 years \- Reporting Experience

  

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**:* Business Planning Effective matrix management skills to influence/escalate for commitments when engaging fix actions. (Required)
* Task Management Strong multi\-tasking skills as well as prioritization of activities to resolve several customer emergencies at the same time. (Required)
* Product Knowledge Solid understanding of customer technologies and all Sprint products and services in order to understand and meet customer requirements. Extensive knowledge of T\-Mobile products and services for effective customer management. (Required)
* Root Cause Analysis Ability to interpret service performance for root cause analysis and corrective action. (Required)
* Communication Demonstrates strong business writing techniques and presentation skills on multiple levels including Customer, Vendor, and Executive.. (Required)
* MS Office Suite Proficient in MS Office \- specifically Excel, Word, Power Point, Visio (Required)
* Presentations Ability to present information to all levels of management up to and including the Executive level for both internal and external customers (Required)

  

**Licenses and Certifications**:* At least 18 years of age
* Legally authorized to work in the United States

jobs.title: Franchise Account Manager Trainer
jobs.description:
**ROLE OVERVIEW**


The Franchise Account Manager (FAM) Trainer is an internal role responsible for designing, delivering, and continuously improving the training ecosystem that cultivates high\-performing Franchise Account Managers. This individual serves as both an expert practitioner and an educator, translating real\-world franchise relationship management into structured learning experiences that accelerate FAM productivity, deepen franchise partner satisfaction, and drive measurable commercial outcomes.

**PURPOSE OF THE ROLE**


The Franchise Account Manager (FAM) Trainer develops and delivers training that helps FAMs become confident, commercially minded franchise relationship managers. This role combines **franchise expertise, sales enablement, performance coaching, and instructional design** to accelerate FAM ramp time, strengthen franchisee relationships, and drive account growth.


The ideal candidate brings **hands\-on franchise or multi\-location experience** along with a strong background in **training, coaching, sales, or account management**.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

### **1\.** **Training Program \& Curriculum Development**

* Design and maintain a structured FAM development program covering onboarding, core skills, advanced capabilities, and ongoing development.
* Create practical training materials including playbooks, talk tracks, workshops, role\-plays, e\-learning, and assessments.
* Develop training around **consultative account management, franchisee relationship management, commercial growth, upselling/cross\-selling, conflict resolution, and performance management.**
* Continuously refresh content based on business needs, performance trends, product changes, and franchisee expectations.

### **2\. Training Delivery \& FAM Onboarding**

* Lead virtual and in\-person training for new FAMs and existing team members.
* Own the FAM onboarding and ramp journey through full productivity, including structured milestones and performance checkpoints.
* Facilitate recurring FAM development sessions and peer\-learning forums.
* Partner with HR, Operations, and FAM leadership to ensure new hires receive the right functional, technical, and cultural training.

### **3\. Performance Coaching \& Call Observation**

* Coach FAMs based on call observations, CRM data, performance metrics, and manager feedback.
* Observe live franchisee calls and provide actionable feedback on discovery, communication, consultative problem\-solving, objection handling, relationship management, and commercial acumen.
* Create individualized development plans for FAMs based on skill gaps and performance needs.
* Support both high\-potential and struggling FAMs through targeted coaching and skill development.

### **4\. Franchisee Relationship \& Conflict Coaching**

* Equip FAMs to confidently manage challenging franchisee conversations and resolve issues before they escalate.
* Coach FAMs on **de\-escalation, expectation setting, objection handling, solution alignment, and professional communication.**
* Help FAMs prepare for difficult conversations by reviewing account history, desired outcomes, and messaging.
* When needed, participate in complex franchisee escalations and model effective relationship\-management and resolution strategies.
* Turn recurring challenges and real\-world scenarios into training content and playbooks.

### **5\. Measurement \& Continuous Improvement**

* Track training effectiveness through ramp time, knowledge assessments, skill progression, performance improvement, and business outcomes.
* Gather learner and manager feedback and continuously improve the FAM development program.
* Identify recurring performance gaps and translate insights into targeted training and coaching initiatives.

### **6\. Cross\-Functional Partnership**

* Partner with FAM leadership, HR, Marketing, Product, Operations, and other teams to ensure training remains commercially relevant and aligned with business priorities.
* Support Sales Kick\-Off, Franchise Summit, and other company\-wide learning initiatives.
* Contribute to career development, competency frameworks, and succession planning for the FAM organization.

**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE**

**Essential**


5\+ years of experience as a Franchise Account Manager, Key Account Manager, or equivalent field sales role within a franchise or multi\-site environment.


2\+ years in a formal training, coaching, or sales enablement capacity (internal or external).


Demonstrated ability to design and deliver structured learning programs; not just on\-the\-job shadowing.


Strong commercial acumen with a proven track record of managing complex franchise or wholesale partner relationships.

**Desirable**


Formal L\&D or coaching qualification (e.g. CIPD L\&D, ICF Coaching, ATD CPTD, or equivalent).


Experience using LMS platforms (e.g. Cornerstone, Docebo, Lessonly/Seismic Learning) and sales enablement tools (e.g. Gong, Chorus, Salesforce).


Background in instructional design methodologies (ADDIE, SAM, or similar frameworks).


Familiarity with franchise disclosure documents (FDD), franchise agreements, and the regulatory landscape.

**Why Ignite Visibility?**

Asset Living is a third\-party management firm and a proven partner in fostering thriving communities nationwide. Gads Hill Center, a social service organization established in 1898, creates opportunities for children and their families to build a better life through education, access to resources, and community engagement.


At Gads Hill Center we envision a community in which all children and youth benefit from healthy, financially stable households that support their learning and growth. We invest in the potential of children, youth, and families through early childhood education, positive youth development, mental health and family support. Ultimately, Gads Hill Center supports building a community where all families can help their children have access to quality education in order to succeed in school and life.

The Program Coordinator is responsible for the planning, implementation, and oversight of the My Chi. My Future. Safe Spaces program at Gads Hill Center, serving youth in the North Lawndale community. This role leads youth workforce development activities and oversees the planning and execution of youth\-driven community events that provide safe, engaging spaces for teens and young adults. jobs.title: Account Manager - North America
jobs.description:
We built and scaled a global customer base from our headquarters in Amsterdam. The United States became one of our most important markets, so we put people on the ground here. Our Chicago office in River North is open and running.

  

You'd be joining early, but not from zero. The person who built and ran our European mid\-market sales team has moved to Chicago. We have an experienced Account Management team in Amsterdam, and you’ll onboard with them to learn every hard\-won lesson from scaling that business: how customers actually get value from the platform, which conversations lead to expansion, how renewals are won long before they're due. Our first U.S. SDR is here, ramped and hitting their numbers. An Account Executive is closing new business alongside you. And one of our product marketers sits in this office, giving you a direct line into the product team when a customer needs something.

  

We've also been increasing investment in our marketing channels month over month, which means a growing customer base in North America for you to build on.

  

The timing couldn't be better. For years, FMCG companies have been stuck with limited choice among legacy market intelligence providers. Every quarter, more of them switch to Vesper. Once they do, the opportunity is to make Vesper indispensable to how they buy. That's your job. And you'll get to visit the canals in Amsterdam from time to time to meet the rest of your colleagues in person.

  

This is not your typical account management role. There's no queue of tickets and no script. You'll be the CEO of your portfolio: responsible for whether customers succeed with Vesper, whether they renew, and how much they grow.

#### **Why you should join us**

* **Own your portfolio outright.** You decide where your time goes, which accounts to invest in, and how to grow them. Real responsibility, no hand\-holding.
* **Retention and expansion, not just check\-ins.** You'll carry a number for both. The best account managers here find revenue that nobody asked them to find.
* **Sell to the toughest audience there is.** Procurement teams negotiate for a living. Renewing and expanding with them is one of the best commercial educations you can get.
* **The European playbook is in the building.** The leader who scaled our mid\-market business in Europe is now based in Chicago, and a Vesper product marketer sits here too, so customer patterns, product answers, and proven approaches are a desk away rather than an eight\-hour time difference.
* **Shape how we do this in North America.** You're senior enough that the way you run onboarding, business reviews, and renewals becomes the pattern the next hires follow. You'll help define the North American customer motion, not inherit it.
* **We invest in your growth.** We bring in outside trainers, run the internal Vesper Academy, and coach you on negotiation, commercial conversations, and account strategy.
* **Face\-to\-face, not just video.** You'll visit strategic accounts across North America and represent Vesper at trade shows and industry events.

#### **What you'll be doing**

* **Own the full post\-sale lifecycle.** Onboarding, adoption, renewal, expansion. You manage all of it, proactively, for your book of North American accounts.
* **Grow your portfolio.** Understand your customers' workflows deeply enough to find expansion opportunities before they surface as requests, then build the business case and close them.
* **Protect and win renewals.** Know where every account stands well ahead of the date, negotiate value rather than discount, and forecast your book honestly.
* **Make customers demonstrably better at their jobs.** You don't need to be a commodity consultant, but you do need to know the platform inside out and how each customer can extract the most value from it based on what they're actually trying to achieve.
* **Keep Vesper essential.** Make sure customers know what the platform can do, stay current on new releases, and treat Vesper as a fixture in their workflow rather than a subscription they review once a year.
* **Feed the roadmap.** Ask the right questions, listen, and get real customer signal back to our product team. With a product marketer down the hall, that loop is short.
* **Set the standard.** As the first local Account Manager, you'll help build the playbook for North American account management and support newer team members as we grow the office.

#### **What you'll bring**

* 4\+ years owning customer relationships commercially, whether as an Account Manager, Customer Success Manager, or Account Executive in technology, or a background in procurement or trading that you've since turned commercial. Roughly four years plus, but experience matters more than the count.
* A track record of carrying and hitting a retention or expansion number
* A strong commercial mindset. What we mean by that: you understand how your customers' businesses work and how they make money, you've negotiated value before, and you actually enjoy the idea of selling something.
* Genuine curiosity about customer workflows, and the discipline to turn what you learn into adoption and revenue
* Comfort using data to decide where your attention goes
* A natural team player. You contribute to the team's target, not just your own, and support the people around you.
* Comfortable in a fast\-paced environment where some processes exist and others you'll build; you learn quickly and adapt as our proposition evolves
* Excellent written and spoken English. Spanish or French is a plus
* Experience with a CRM is helpful (we use HubSpot)
* Willingness to travel across North America for customer visits and industry events
* Authorization to work in the United States without visa sponsorship
* Based in Chicago, or willing to relocate, and able to work on\-site

*The role can be a Senior Account Manager for candidates with the right experience.*

#### **What you get**

* Personal responsibility with a ton of autono

We are seeking a results\-driven **National Account Manager** to drive new business growth within the restaurant chain industry. This is a highly focused business development role responsible for identifying and prospecting target accounts, building a strong pipeline, developing winning account strategies, and converting opportunities into long\-term customer relationships.


The ideal candidate is a proactive sales hunter with a proven ability to open doors, engage key decision\-makers, negotiate effectively, and close complex deals. * Develop and execute strategic account plans to achieve volume, revenue, and profitability targets. Cultivate new customer opportunities to expand our product portfolio.

Communicate customer needs internally to evaluate profitability, operational capability, and capacity. Collaborate cross\-functionally with sales, marketing, and operations teams to develop and deliver solutions that meet customer requirements and drive business growth.
* Develop and maintain strong working relationships with key stakeholders at assigned accounts through collaboration, networking, participation in industry associations and trade shows, and regular sales engagement. Conduct periodic business reviews with customers to ensure satisfaction, evaluate performance, and identify opportunities for growth and expansion
* Negotiate contracts, pricing, and service agreements with key decision\-makers. Develop and implement strategies that drive business growth while ensuring sustainable and profitable long\-term partnerships.

**What We Offer Employees**


Phenomenal Benefits: Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance plans, 401(k) with company contributions, a generous time off program, life and disability insurance, adoption assistance, a scholarship program for children of employees, and an employee assistance program for you and your family.


Competitive Compensation: The expected base pay range for this role is between $160,000 to $170,000 annually, although a final salary offer is dependent on the candidate's experience level and skill set. In addition to a competitive base salary, this position participates in a sales incentive plan.

**We're Looking for Someone With:**

* Minimum of 5 years of experience in foodservice sales to national restaurant chain accounts *(Quick Service, Fast Casual or Casual Dining)*
* Bachelor's degree from a four\-year college or university, or equivalent combination of education \& experience
* Ability to travel up to 50% of the time
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
* Strong negotiation, presentation, and relationship\-building skills
* Self\-motivated, creative, and innovative, with a strong drive to achieve results
* Strong analytical and account planning skills
* Intermediate skills in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Excel

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, High Touch
jobs.description:
Fin is the AI Customer Agent company on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.



Our AI Agent Fin is the highest\-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always\-on customer support across the customer journey – from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end\-to\-end across every channel, with minimal set\-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk for one single system that is designed to meet the needs of modern day support teams.



Founded in 2011, Fin became one of the fastest growing companies and remains one of the largest private software companies in the world with nearly 30,000 global businesses using our products to transform their customer support. Driven by our core values, we push boundaries, build with speed and intensity, and relentlessly deliver incredible value to our customers.

**What's the opportunity?**
---------------------------



As a High Touch CSM, you’ll partner with our largest and most complex customers to help them succeed in the new era of AI\-driven customer service. You’ll work with C\-suite leaders and their Support teams to guide them through their AI Agent transformation with Fin — from early project scoping and requirements gathering, to measurable adoption, to industry\-best automation rates and business outcomes.



This role is an opportunity to shape how the world’s leading companies deploy AI to transform their support operations and achieve strategic outcomes aligned to their business goals.


**What will I be doing?**
-------------------------


* Develop trusted advisor relationships with customers (from c\-suite stakeholders to individual contributors).
* Facilitate requirements gathering and process mapping for the customer’s standard operating procedures; document in clear, precise, and actionable terms.
* Collaborate with engineers to translate customer requirements into Fin solution designs, guiding the customer on configuration best practices and prompt strategy.
* Monitor Fin usage patterns to identify risks, recommend optimizations, and uncover expansion opportunities.
* Maintain deep product knowledge of Fin’s fast\-expanding capabilities; remain market aware of the fast evolving AI\-agent industry.
* Lead Success Plans, QBRs/EBRs, and strategic planning sessions with the customer.
* Prioritize competing demands to drive the highest\-value outcomes across your customer portfolio.
* Be the Voice of the Customer internally, advocating for customers’ needs and shaping our solutions strategy.

**What skills do I need?**
--------------------------


* 3\-5 years of relevant work experience in a customer\-facing customer success, account management or strategic consulting organization. SaaS or Consumption\-based Technology companies experience a benefit.
* Experience with business process mapping, requirements analysis, and solution design.
* Strong technical acumen and passion for AI/agent\-building (coding not required).
* Ability to simplify and communicate complex problems clearly across audiences.
* Strong prioritization skills to effectively manage a broad portfolio of customer accounts while delivering depth of impact.
* Demonstrated success driving adoption, process improvement, and measurable outcomes for enterprise customers.
* Self\-motivated, adaptable, and curious team player with a high level of self\-efficacy.


* Proof of eligibility to work in the United States is required.



The base salary range for candidates within the Greater Chicago Area is $135,270 \- $161,575\. Actual base pay will depend on a variety of factors such as education, skills, experience, location, etc. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All regular employees may also be eligible for the corporate bonus program or a sales incentive (target included in OTE) as well as stock in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).


At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements.  

  

Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at fin.ai/careers.


**Policies**



Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.



We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non\-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our core values.


Fin values diversity and is committed to a policy of Equal Employment Opportunity. Fin will not discriminate against an applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, age, physical or mental disability, veteran or military status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Chowbus is a leading AI\-powered restaurant technology SaaS platform with deep roots in the North American market. We support thousands of restaurants of every size across the U.S. and Canada, with technology solutions spanning POS, AI, and digital tools that help restaurants run more efficiently and grow their business. We compete with companies like Toast, Square, Clover, and Menusifu. Our Marketing team plays a direct role in that growth.



We are looking for a Digital Marketing Manager to own Chowbus's digital presence end to end: organic search, our website, marketing analytics, and paid search. You'll turn data into decisions and help restaurant owners find Chowbus and book a demo. You'll work closely with fellow Marketing team members, Sales colleagues, and Product specialists to keep our digital funnel consistent from first click to conversion.



This is ahybrid role based in our Chicago office.



**What You'll Focus On**
------------------------


**SEO \& Organic Growth**


* Own Chowbus's SEO roadmap, including keyword strategy, technical SEO audits, site structure, and page speed/Core Web Vitals improvements.
* Run competitive SEO analysis against Toast, Square, Clover, and Menusifu to find content and ranking opportunities.
* Partner with the content team to brief, optimize, and publish SEO\-driven blog posts, landing pages, and city\- or cuisine\-specific pages.
* Monitor rankings, organic traffic, and backlink profile using tools like Google Search Console, SEMrush, or Ahrefs, and report on progress monthly.


**Website \& CMS Management**


* Own day\-to\-day management of Chowbus's website CMS, including page builds, edits, navigation, and content governance.
* Launch and maintain landing pages for campaigns, product launches, and events, working with design and demand generation partners.
* Run A/B tests on key pages (homepage, demo request forms, pricing) to improve conversion rates.
* Maintain site performance, uptime, and technical hygiene, partnering with engineering as needed.


**Marketing Analytics \& Reporting**


* Build and maintain dashboards in GA4, Tableau, or similar tools to track website traffic, campaign performance, and lead\-to\-demo conversion.
* Define and track the digital marketing funnel from first touch to booked demo, in partnership with Sales and RevOps.
* Deliver monthly and quarterly performance reports with clear takeaways and recommendations for marketing leadership.
* Work with RevOps and Sales to keep lead data clean and consistent across the website, CRM, and marketing automation platform.

  

  

**Paid Search (Google Ads / PPC)**


* Plan, launch, and manage Google Ads campaigns (Search, Display, Performance Max) to drive qualified demo requests.
* Own the paid search budget, bidding strategy, and keyword lists. Optimize continuously for cost per lead and ROAS.
* Write and test ad copy, landing pages, and offers to improve click\-through and conversion rates.
* Partner with the Marketing Campaigns Manager so paid search complements paid social and ABM efforts.

**What You Bring**
------------------


* 6\+ years of experience in digital marketing, with hands\-on ownership of SEO, website/CMS, analytics, and paid search (Google Ads).
* Proven experience improving organic search rankings and traffic using tools like Google Search Console, SEMrush, or Ahrefs.
* Hands\-on experience managing a CMS (WordPress, Webflow, or similar), including landing page builds and site edits.
* Strong experience with Google Analytics (GA4\) and building reporting dashboards (Looker or similar).
* Experience managing a paid search budget and reporting on ROAS and cost per lead.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience in restaurant technology, POS, payments, fintech, or another B2B SaaS company.
* Experience at a high\-growth startup or scale\-up.
* Familiarity with HubSpot, Salesforce, or a similar CRM/marketing automation platform.
* Basic HTML/CSS knowledge for CMS edits.
* Preferred: Professional or fluent proficiency in Mandarin Chinese. Most of our team and many of our restaurant partners communicate in Mandarin, so this skill helps you collaborate effectively and understand our customers.

**What We Offer**
-----------------


* Competitive compensation package
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k)
* 100% employer\-paid Short\-Term Disability (STD)
* 100% employer\-paid Life Insurance
* 100% employer\-paid AD\&D Insurance
* Company holidays
* Birthday off
* Paid Parental Leave
* Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)


**The salary for this role is $80,000–$130,000, depending on experience. This role may also be eligible for a performance bonus.**

jobs.title: Outbound Sales Development Representative (SDR)
jobs.description:
Muck Rack is the leading SaaS platform for public relations and communications professionals. Our mission is to enable organizations to build trust, tell their stories, and demonstrate the unique value of earned media. Muck Rack's AI\-powered, comprehensive, and integrated platform streamlines the PR workflow to help businesses generate positive media coverage, monitor mentions to manage brand reputation, and analyze PR's impact on business outcomes. By combining media database, monitoring, and reporting into one dynamic platform, we empower teams to collaborate seamlessly, pitch effectively, and analyze results faster and more efficiently.



Founder\-controlled, fully distributed, and growing sustainably, Muck Rack has received several awards for its unparalleled culture and product from organizations like Inc., Quartz, G2, and BuiltIn. We value resilience, transparency, ownership, and customer devotion, and infuse these values into everything we do.


We're growing quickly, and we're looking for an ambitious, tech\-savvy, and detail\-oriented **Outbound Sales Development Representative** to join our team and make a big impact.



As an Outbound SDR at Muck Rack, you will work closely with our sales team to generate opportunities through outbound outreach. You should be excited about working in a fast\-paced sales environment where you'll be the first "face" of Muck Rack to prospective customers, representing our team, culture, and brand.


**What you'll do:**
-------------------


* **Build pipeline through outbound outreach** — prospect leads via email, LinkedIn, and phone to consistently meet and exceed quota
* **Personalize your interactions** — leverage Muck Rack's tools and prospect insights to make outreach timely, relevant, and informed from the first touch
* **Prospect strategically**— develop efficient, creative outreach systems tailored to target accounts, using our systems to identify patterns and prioritize who to contact and when
* **Plan your day with purpose** — lean on AI\-assisted workflows to structure your time, stay on top of follow\-ups, and keep your pipeline moving without things falling through the cracks
* **Stay plugged into PR** — monitor industry news to surface timely, relevant outreach opportunities
* **Maintain clean CRM hygiene** — keep lead records, activities, and reporting accurate and up to date in Salesforce
* **Collaborate cross\-functionally** — partner closely with Account Executives and Marketing to align outreach efforts and drive pipeline growth
* **Maintain consistent activity standards** — execute against outreach expectations across segments while balancing quality personalization with high\-volume prospecting

### **How success will be measured in this role:**


* Meetings booked, held, and converted to pipeline (S2 opportunities)
* SDR\-sourced revenue

**If the details below describe you, you could be a great fit for this role:**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------


* 1\+ year of experience in a SaaS SDR role *or* 1\+ year working in PR preferred— you understand either the sales motion or the buyer's world
* Highly accountable and self\-motivated, with a growth mindset that welcomes feedback and coaching
* A natural relationship builder with genuine curiosity and a sales\-oriented mindset
* Exceptional written communication skills — you write emails that actually get read and responses that move things forward
* Strong phone presence — you can build rapport quickly and keep a conversation going
* Ability to juggle multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, startup environment without dropping the ball
* A quick study with new tools (including AI tools) — we work in Google Workspace, Salesforce, Outreach, Slack, Nooks, SalesNav, etc
* Based or willing to work East Coast or Central hours
* Proactively incorporate AI tools into day to day work to improve productively and accelerate delivery

### **Interview Overview**



Below you'll find an outline of the interview plan for this role. Please note that this is what we expect the process to look like; we may ask you for supplemental information or require an additional step before making a final decision.


* Skills Assessment
* 15\-minute Recruiter Screen with SDR Manager
* 45\-minute Zoom interview with the hiring manager, including a mock cold call
* Panel interview with several members of our team
* 30\-minute Bar Raiser

### **Travel \& Team Engagement Expectations**



This role requires up to 10% travel for team collaboration, customer engagements, and company events. As part of our commitment to building strong connections across our fully distributed team, attendance at our annual company offsite (typically held in Mexico) is expected.


### **Salary**



In the US, the base salary for this role is $53,000, with $68,000\+ in OTE. Note that we typically build 1\-3 quarters of ramp time with lower goals and thus lower earnings from commissions. We take a geo\-neutral approach to compensation within the US, meaning that we pay based on job function and level, not location. For all other countries, we have competitive pay bands based on market standards.


###### **Individual compensation decisions are based on a number of factors, including experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company. We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. We recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted. If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.**

* Home office stipend, phone and internet reimbursement, coworking membership

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close\-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

  

**Department Overview**
-----------------------

The Sales Development Representative is responsible for following up on leads and building pipeline for sellers across all of Motorola's North American Government Sales organization. We represent all of Motorola Solution's products and endeavor to help our customers in their quest of "Solving for Safer" by using our end\-to\-end suite of safety products.
**Job Description**
-------------------

The Sales Development Representative is a key contributor in a rapid growth company while representing a product suite that makes an impact on people's lives. Motorola Solutions is a global leader in public safety and enterprise security. Join our team and help us continue to grow!


**Responsibilities include:**

* Run call cadences (with support of an automated dialer) to educate our future customers on the value our solutions bring and drive interest in an initial conversation.
* Ask smart, targeted questions to build rapport with our prospects and identify opportunities.
* Focus on targeted outbound list.
* Collaborate with seasoned sales professionals within a territory you support to find, develop and build key stakeholder interest, and crystalize the needs of the organization across multiple customer profiles and buyer groups.
* Re\-engage lapsed and long\-term leads as we introduce new product features with a focus on bringing them back into the funnel.
* Record prospect interactions and update records within our CRM.

**Qualifications:**

* Ability to articulate value propositions via phone, video, email, and other various social networking platforms.
* Detail oriented, take exceptional meeting/activity notes, and effective in task and time management.
* Highly motivated, passionate, and results driven.
* Willing and able to contribute to team efforts by accomplishing related tasks as needed .
* Commitment to company vision, mission and values.

Target Base Salary Range: $48,000 \- $52,000 USD


Consistent with Motorola Solutions values and applicable law, we provide the following information to promote pay transparency and equity. Pay within this range varies and depends on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The actual offer will be based on the individual candidate.


\#LI\-RO1

  

**Basic Requirements**
----------------------

* Graduating with a Bachelor's Degree on or before July 2027

**Travel Requirements**
-----------------------

Under 10%
**Relocation Provided**
-----------------------

None
**Position Type**
-----------------

New Grad
**Referral Payment Plan**
-------------------------

Yes
**Our U.S. Benefits include:**

* Incentive Bonus Plans
* Medical, Dental, Vision benefits
* 401K with Company Match
* 10 Paid Holidays
* Generous Paid Time Off Packages
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Paid Parental \& Family Leave
* and more!

  

***EEO Statement***

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally\-protected characteristic.


We are proud of our people\-first and community\-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.


We’re committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience for candidates with disabilities, or other physical or mental health conditions. To request an accommodation, please complete this Reasonable Accommodations Form so we can assist you.

**Considerations:** Chicago GlueMachine is a leading adhesive and adhesive equipment distributor in the Midwest and one of the largest in the United States. The Inside Sales Business Development Associate plays a critical role in driving growth by managing inbound sales inquiries, developing new business opportunities, managing existing accounts and supporting outside sales representatives.


This role serves as a primary point of contact for prospects and customers who can be supported remotely. Success in this position requires strong communication skills, disciplined CRM usage, curiosity about customer operations, and the ability to connect customer needs with CGM solutions.


Approximately 70 percent of the role is spent on phone and video calls, email communication, CRM activity, and virtual meetings with prospects and customers.


Approximately 20 percent of the role is dedicated to managing key accounts in territories where CGM does not have physical representation.


Approximately 10 percent of the role may involve travel for customer meetings, trade shows, training, or internal collaboration.


Chicago Glue and Machine fosters an entrepreneurial spirit. Our business thrives through the efforts of our team being self\-starters and empowered to use their creativity to quickly capitalize on opportunities. The ideal Inside Sales Business Development Associate must be resilient, energetic, determined, willing to learn, and take great initiative to be successful. They must be able to engage prospects in discussions that underline the value Chicago GlueMachine can bring to their operations.


**Primary Responsibilities**

* Manage and respond to inbound sales inquiries in a timely, professional manner
* Qualify inbound leads and route opportunities appropriately between business development, inside and outside sales
* Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified opportunities
* Maintain and expand the company's prospect and customer database
* Own accurate and timely CRM updates including notes, activities, opportunity stages, and next steps
* Conduct outbound prospecting to identify new business opportunities
* Manage a defined territory or group of key accounts supported remotely
* Identify customer needs and position CGM products, services, and technical expertise accordingly
* Research accounts, industries, and market trends to support sales and marketing efforts
* Support quoting, follow up, and coordination with internal teams as needed
* Use and follow tools and processes within the Quality Management System
* Support marketing initiatives such as trade shows, campaigns, blog content, or customer outreach
* Leverage, follow, and continuously improve CGM's sales process

**Skills:**

* Strong Active listening
* Clear verbal and written communication
* Ability to ask thoughtful questions and uncover customer needs
* Problem\-solving and follow through
* Time management and prioritization
* Persistence and Resilience
* Microsoft Office and database software
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively

**Characteristics:**

* Self\-starter who takes initiative
* Comfort with accountability and measurable goals
* Willingness to learn technical products and applications
* Ability to manage pressure and shifting priorities

**Requirements:**

* High School diploma required
* Ability to pass background check and drug screen




**Benefits:**

* 10 paid holidays
* Choice of HMO or PPO Medical Insurance, Dental and Vision Insurance offered
* FSA
* Short Term Disability
* Long Term Disability
* 401k, 3% employer match




Work is performed indoors in normal office setting. Conditions may vary on occasional trips to customer sites.

The Sales Development Representative plays a key role in generating and qualifying leads, supporting the sales team, and building strong customer relationships. This individual will engage with prospective and existing customers, identify opportunities for growth, and help deliver exceptional customer experience.  


If you have people skills and want to build your career centered around human relationships, this is the role for you.

* Enter and maintain lead and customer information within company databases and CRM platforms, including Mailchimp.

Minimum 1 year of experience in a sales role with quota or performance\-based goals.  
Proven ability to meet or exceed sales targets.  
Experience in retail sales, inside sales, customer service sales, or business development is highly preferred.  
Retail sales professionals with a demonstrated track record of driving revenue and building customer relationships are strongly encouraged to apply.  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.  
Strong customer service and relationship\-building abilities.  
Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage time effectively.  
Proficiency with Microsoft Office and CRM/database systems.  
Detail\-oriented with strong organizational skills.  
Experience in furniture, lighting, home furnishings, or related industries is a plus.  


Why Join LumiSource?  


Flexible hours from Monday through Friday  
Opportunity to build a long\-term sales career in a growing industry.  
Work with nationally recognized retail and e\-commerce partners.  
Collaborative and supportive team environment.

jobs.title: Assistant Community Manager
jobs.description:
Overview:

At RPM, we’re in the business of extraordinary. We believe people\-first is the way to success which is why we provide top industry pay, comprehensive benefits, and a path of upward mobility via career training and education. Join us and start your extraordinary journey today.  

Position Summary:

The Assistant Community Manager greets prospects, processes applications, manages leases and renewals, handles rent collections and evictions, and promotes resident satisfaction and property visibility through effective communication and social media.
Responsibilities:
* Greet and qualify prospects professionally using guest cards in our Lead Management Software. Assist prospects with applications and deposits, adhering to company procedures and Fair Housing requirements
* Keep an updated availability report, process applications (including credit checks and rental history verification), submit them for the Community Manager's approval, and follow up with applicants on their status
* Show apartments and close sale, prepare them for move\-ins, obtain new residents' signatures on paperwork, and provide community orientation
* Manage lease renewals, send renewal notices, handle move\-outs based on lease terms, apply fees when necessary, and keep property management software updated with move\-in/out and renewal data
* Manage rental collections, enforce lease terms, track fees, and initiate eviction when needed for financial compliance and revenue optimization
* Promote resident satisfaction and retention by promptly responding to complaints, questions, and requests and taking appropriate actions to resolve service issues
* Follow eviction procedures, including notice requirements, court representation, and facilitating proceedings as needed
* Conduct market research by surveying competing properties, implement outreach marketing, and update Radix (or equivalent) as needed
* Assist in maintaining an active and effective social media presence for the property to enhance visibility and engagement  

Completes all necessary paperwork for generating a lease, move\-in, check\-out, and other peak periods in a timely manner


Education and Experience:
* High school diploma or GED
* At least one year of experience in customer service or apartment leasing. A background in accounting combined with customer service is also preferred
* Microsoft Office Suite, Project Management
* Illinois Residential Leasing Agent License Required


Qualifications:
**Physical Requirements:*** May be required to sit for extended periods of time while working at a desk
* May be required to climb stairs
* Must be able to read documents, computer screens and data
* Must be able to hear and understand verbal communications in person and over the phone or computer
* May occasionally be required to lift or carry items such as files or office supplies weighing up to 20 pounds
* Must be able to operate a computer, keyboard, mouse and other office equipment

**Work Environment:*** This role is based on site and requires that the employee spend time outside with exposure to the elements
* May require working in confined spaces, heights and potentially hazardous areas
* A flexible schedule is required and hours include weekdays, nights, and weekends (including Saturdays and Sundays) as needed to meet business needs

* Opportunities for professional development, career growth, and role\-based learning plans
* Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) and multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERG)
